Targets who succeed take 1d12+1 magic damage. Targets who fail take double damage and are knocked back to Close range.

Basilisk.name: Basilisk
Basilisk.description: A six-legged monitor lizard that has the head of a vulture, a spiked backbone, and a petrifying gaze.
Basilisk.motivesAndTactics: Move slow and steady, savor petrified prey, turn everyone to stone, watch and wait

Ik7qhV4eOE9ZxWUT.name: Petrify
Ik7qhV4eOE9ZxWUT.description: Spend a Fear to force a PC within Far range to make an Instinct Reaction Roll. On a success, the target marks a Stress. On a failure, the target becomes Stiff . If the target is already Stiff , they become Petrified. While Stiff , the PC must mark a Stress each time they act until they take a rest or the @Lookup[@name] is defeated. While Petrified, the PC can't act. The Petrified condition can be cleared only by applying @Lookup[@name] saliva to the target.

WXxNVW4vIPdICvzC.name: Make Petrified
WXxNVW4vIPdICvzC.description: On a failure, the target becomes Stiff. If the target is already Stiff, they become Petrified.

02gVh8EwMcKr3SDU.name: Stiff
02gVh8EwMcKr3SDU.description: While Stiff, the PC must mark a Stress each time they act until they take a rest or the Basilisk is defeated.

dlmzLzGxxxIISWlH.name: Petrified
dlmzLzGxxxIISWlH.description: While Petrified, the PC can't act. The Petrified condition can be cleared only by applying Basilisk saliva to the target.

0antvuNtKPuppXdr.name: CRONCH!
0antvuNtKPuppXdr.description: Mark a Stress to have the @Lookup[@name] chomp down on a Petrified PC within Melee range. The target must make a death move.

Berserker Alpha.name: Berserker Alpha
Berserker Alpha.description: A veteran commander who quaff s magic elixirs to change into a beast and lead their packmates on a hunt.
Berserker Alpha.motivesAndTactics: Embrace the change, howl at the moon, lead the pack, run down enemies

SEvAYlwvFdLMx0yZ.name: Pack Fury
SEvAYlwvFdLMx0yZ.description: The Alpha gains a +1 bonus to their attack rolls for each ally within Very Close range of their attack's target.

ky9NeQ55xa1TdP5j.name: Bark at the Moon
ky9NeQ55xa1TdP5j.description: Once per scene, spend a Fear to have each ally within Close range of the Alpha clear a HP and a Stress.

GmBst1S1DyM4gxZe.name: Berserker Rage
GmBst1S1DyM4gxZe.description: The first time in a scene the Alpha marks their last Stress, they gain a +6 bonus to damage rolls.

Berserker Initiate.name: Berserker Initiate
Berserker Initiate.description: A raging warrior who imbibes ritualistic concoctions to enhance their form with aspects of a predatory beast.
Berserker Initiate.motivesAndTactics: Coordinate with packmates, dance around the fire, howl at the moon

OQOMsj3lpNIeJryN.name: Pack Fury
OQOMsj3lpNIeJryN.description: The Initiate gains a +1 bonus to their attack rolls for each ally within Very Close range of their attack's target.

a3VYAXAv5BC6DgqG.name: Berserker Rage
a3VYAXAv5BC6DgqG.description: The first time in a scene the Initiate marks their last Stress, they gain a +4 bonus to damage rolls.

Bugboar.name: Bugboar
Bugboar.description: A large bipedal creature that has a tusked snout and coarse fur.
Bugboar.motivesAndTactics: Ambush, bully, seek carnage and shiny things

1NsdEyGbRIVsyUtw.name: Surprise!
1NsdEyGbRIVsyUtw.description: If the @Lookup[@name] makes its first attack in a scene before it's marked HP or Stress, it has advantage on the attack and deals an extra 1d8 damage.

kk2cwy2BB3qVqEYK.name: Brutal
kk2cwy2BB3qVqEYK.description: When the @Lookup[@name] makes a successful standard attack, you can mark a Stress to deal an extra 1d6 damage.

iIv8oE9H4wuyg0Jy.name: Warheart
iIv8oE9H4wuyg0Jy.description: When a condition would be imposed on the @Lookup[@name], you can spend a Fear to negate it.

Catrin.name: Catrin
Catrin.description: A lavishly adorned skeleton that has an endless appetite for gold.
Catrin.motivesAndTactics: Dominate the conversation, seek attention, steal everything

bWCHZQfgYqwp0Rs9.name: Attracted to Wealth
bWCHZQfgYqwp0Rs9.description: PCs carrying at least a bag of gold gain advantage on Presence Rolls made to influence the @Lookup[@name].

bO98mAUQq9W3rWrE.name: The Weight of Opulence
bO98mAUQq9W3rWrE.description: Spend a Fear to turn the @Lookup[@name]'s gaze toward the PC carrying the most gold. The target must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or lose a Hope for each bag of gold they're carrying. If the PC loses their last Hope or has no Hope to lose, they mark Stress instead.

xv5ezYG0YFD4nrIq.name: Expensive Failure
xv5ezYG0YFD4nrIq.description: When a PC within Melee range fails an action roll, you can mark a Stress to have the @Lookup[@name] brazenly steal a handful of gold from them.

Centaur Warden.name: Centaur Warden
Centaur Warden.description: A half-human, half-horse guardian who patrols the borders of idyllic lands uncorrupted by the touch of civilization.
Centaur Warden.motivesAndTactics: Live in harmony with nature, protect the wilderness, use mobility and distance to drive off intruders

XHGUxa8QoKr3roGW.name: Flanking Maneuver
XHGUxa8QoKr3roGW.description: When the Warden makes a standard attack against a target within Melee range of one or more of the Warden's allies, the Warden gains a +2 bonus to the attack roll.

kCja1GQZTFbMk7Zm.name: Flanking Maneuver
kCja1GQZTFbMk7Zm.description: When the Warden makes a standard attack against a target within Melee range of one or more of the Warden's allies, the Warden gains a +2 bonus to the attack roll.

UtxsNofV59V2WXSN.name: Eye of the Sage
UtxsNofV59V2WXSN.description: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack. The Warden has advantage on the attack roll and critically succeeds on a roll of 19–20.

bb0EOEX68WRKfr20.name: Trample
bb0EOEX68WRKfr20.description: Spend a Fear to have the Warden gallop up to Far range in a straight line. Each target in their path must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who succeed take 1d6+2 physical damage. Targets who fail take double damage and must mark a Stress.

iX7ofHjr4Cdk3PKE.name: Quick Volley
iX7ofHjr4Cdk3PKE.description: When the Warden makes a standard attack, you can mark any number of Stress to target an equal number of additional creatures within range.

Cephilith Abomination.name: Cephilith Abomination
Cephilith Abomination.description: A lumbering, bog-grown frog beast that has tadpolelike leeches visibly wriggling underneath their translucent skin.
Cephilith Abomination.motivesAndTactics: Do the heavy lifting, leap menacingly, move surprisingly fast, smash and grab

MFkY0BD2EhKp9lTo.name: Toxic Skin
MFkY0BD2EhKp9lTo.description: A PC who comes into physical contact with the Abomination must roll a d6. On a result of 3 or lower, the PC must mark an Armor Slot or 2 HP.

bSG0fOnMCgOFVdpP.name: Bear Hug
bSG0fOnMCgOFVdpP.description: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, the target takes standard damage and is Grappled until they escape with a successful Strength Roll. While Grappled, the target is Vulnerable and Restrained.

2PJ338qQ7O8uDiW4.name: Bear Hug
2PJ338qQ7O8uDiW4.description:
You are Grappled until you escape with a successful Strength Roll.

While Grappled, the target is Vulnerable and Restrained.

eNlJcvDxqoyCPtW6.name: Crunch!
eNlJcvDxqoyCPtW6.description: Spend a Fear to deal 4d12 direct physical damage to a creature Grappled by the Abomination.

7DSC9gbRVC7j7nKh.name: Tongue Attack
7DSC9gbRVC7j7nKh.description: Spend a Fear to have the Abomination pull a target within Far range into Melee range, then immediately spotlight the Abomination again.

EzVuIjxfpU0ySdyq.name: Burrowing Leechpoles
EzVuIjxfpU0ySdyq.description: When the Abomination takes Major or greater damage, their skin erupts in an explosion of subcutaneous wrigglers. Each PC within Close range must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail are covered in [[/r 2d4]] leechpoles, which burrow under their skin. Until the leechpoles are dug out with a successful Finesse Roll (21), any damage the target takes gains a +1 bonus for each leechpole under their skin.

XRFLX5qMJco6vnLG.name: Leechpoles
XRFLX5qMJco6vnLG.description: Until the leechpoles are dug out with a successful Finesse Roll (21), any damage the target takes gains a +1 bonus for each leechpole under their skin.

Cephilith Hatchling.name: Cephilith Hatchling
Cephilith Hatchling.description: A squidlike parasite that latches onto their prey's skull, bathing the victim's brain in extradimensional neurotoxins.

is4t4iHrOBy2tSuD.name: Minion (12)
is4t4iHrOBy2tSuD.description: The Hatchling is defeated when they take any damage. For every 12 damage a PC deals to the Hatchling, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

el7eTepwDBzJVJ2z.name: Comatize
el7eTepwDBzJVJ2z.description:
Spend a Fear to have the Hatchling latch onto the head of a PC within Melee range. The PC must mark a Stress as the Hatchling injects the PC's brain with psycho-chemicals, and they must mark an additional Stress each time any PC fails a roll with Fear. The PC can remove the Hatchling by spending a number of Hope equal to the number of Stress they have marked. If a PC marks their last Stress while the Hatchling is latched on, the PC must make a death move.

If the PC dies, you can spend a Fear to resurrect them as a Cephilith Novitiate.

JvTbZJPusa99dZph.name: Embedded Hatchling
JvTbZJPusa99dZph.description:
You must mark an additional Stress each time any PC fails a roll with Fear.

You can remove the Hatchling by spending a number of Hope equal to the number of Stress you have marked. If you mark your last Stress while the Hatchling is latched on, you must make a death move.

0ys64jwVIc6yagjB.name: Group Attack
0ys64jwVIc6yagjB.description: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all @Lookup[@name]s within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 9 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

Cephilith Novitiate.name: Cephilith Novitiate
Cephilith Novitiate.description: A luminary of the Mortal Realm who has given their mind to extradimensional entities in exchange for eldritch abilities.
Cephilith Novitiate.motivesAndTactics: Help others see the Truth, make way for It, seek forbidden knowledge

51jjStc5Lv9zAu14.name: Minion (12)
51jjStc5Lv9zAu14.description: The Novitiate is defeated when they take any damage. For every 12 damage a PC deals to the Novitiate, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

OpPYnhqeYotcyobD.name: Group Attack
OpPYnhqeYotcyobD.description: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all @Lookup[@name]s within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 12 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

bAxGTMuqrqkKcvZP.name: Sacrifice Self
bAxGTMuqrqkKcvZP.description: Spend a Fear to have the Novitiate charge at a target within Far range and melt into them. Deal 12 direct magic damage to the target and defeat the Novitiate.

Cephilith Priest.name: Cephilith Priest
Cephilith Priest.description: A perpetually moist, faceless humanoid from the Outer Realms who has elongated fingers and translucent skin, under which one can see wriggling worms.
Cephilith Priest.motivesAndTactics: Break the unbelievers' minds, prepare this world for the Cephilith Titan's arrival, sing its praises

cVDi7HxrpgdaKIps.name: Psychic Blast
cVDi7HxrpgdaKIps.description: Spend a Fear to choose up to three PCs within Close range and force them to make a Knowledge Reaction Roll. Targets who succeed take 2d10+5 direct magic damage. Targets who fail take 4d10+10 direct magic damage and are Vulnerable until spotlighted.

WXxRFMvq0LjWyNEj.name: Cerebral Incursion
WXxRFMvq0LjWyNEj.description: Spend a Fear to choose a Vulnerable target within Melee range. The Priest grabs the target and inserts their elongated fingers into the target's ears, nose, and mouth. The target must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll or mark 1d6 Stress, and the Priest clears an equal number of Stress.

DD6c2yZwZGEh9dud.name: Telekinetic Grasp
DD6c2yZwZGEh9dud.description: When the Priest makes a successful standard attack against a PC, you can mark a Stress to Restrain the target until they spend a Hope.

aIb49txPodEzSnGS.name: Grasped
aIb49txPodEzSnGS.description: You are Restrained until you spend a Hope.

Cephilith Titan.name: Cephilith Titan
Cephilith Titan.description: A transdimensional entity in the form of an impossibly large, winged humanoid with an octopus-shaped head and rows of glowing eyes.
Cephilith Titan.motivesAndTactics: Call and consume followers, corrupt reality, invade the Mortal Realm, spew forth chaos

Ku1IguoeLopi1W50.name: Relentless (X)
Ku1IguoeLopi1W50.description: The Titan can be spotlighted up to X times per GM turn, where X equals the number of PCs in the scene. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

YqANVDSnjcVCK5vm.name: Terrifying
YqANVDSnjcVCK5vm.description: When the Titan makes a successful attack, all PCs within Close range lose a Hope, and you gain a Fear.

f5nHfI6lZtudtZ3j.name: Merely a Projection
f5nHfI6lZtudtZ3j.description: The Titan appears in the Mortal Realm as a psychic projection approximating its true form. They have immunity to physical damage and resistance to magic damage.

Kk4cbk8xFxBIobxI.name: Merely a Projection
Kk4cbk8xFxBIobxI.description: The Titan appears in the Mortal Realm as a psychic projection approximating its true form. They have immunity to physical damage and resistance to magic damage.

MXC78VtfVHw6pQ5e.name: Psychic Scream
MXC78VtfVHw6pQ5e.description: Spend a Fear to have the Titan unleash a mind-shattering onslaught of nightmarish visions from the Outer Realms. Each PC within Far range must make an Instinct Reaction Roll (22). Targets who fail take 4d12 direct magic damage. Targets who succeed must mark a Stress.

DKl9G56DwWpLVblv.name: Summon Worshippers
DKl9G56DwWpLVblv.description: Spend a Fear to summon 1d4 Cephilith Abominations, which appear within Far range, then choose one to immediately spotlight.

SGaUcNeQ3Y7F0Tlf.name: "It's Here…"
SGaUcNeQ3Y7F0Tlf.description: When the Titan has marked half its HP, they manifests in their full form, clearing all HP and losing the "Merely a Projection" feature. While the Titan is in this form, a creature who marks HP from the Titan's standard attack must mark an additional HP.

thBjAMP3WaNYxyJp.name: It's Here…
thBjAMP3WaNYxyJp.description: While the Titan is in this form, a creature who marks HP from the Titan's standard attack must mark an additional HP.

Chicken-foot Hut.name: Chicken-foot Hut
Chicken-foot Hut.description: A tall wooden shack that moves around on giant chicken legs.
Chicken-foot Hut.motivesAndTactics: Claw, protect master, run and jump, trample

2GmCyknwoYSebFLO.name: Fast
2GmCyknwoYSebFLO.description: The Hut can move up to Far range when spotlighted.

N9tz3fFJ5DFerV0u.name: Double Strike
N9tz3fFJ5DFerV0u.description: Mark a Stress to make two standard attacks. If both attacks succeed against the same target, combine the damage.

TAcEerFCrdmDvKHL.name: Pin
TAcEerFCrdmDvKHL.description: When the Hut makes a successful standard attack, you can mark a Stress to temporarily Restrain the target. The Hut drags the Restrained target when it moves.

TmPOgMEhFSv1ZPIf.name: Pinned
TmPOgMEhFSv1ZPIf.description: You are Restrained. The Hut drags you along when it moves.

Chimera.name: Chimera
Chimera.description: A giant fire-breathing monster that has a lion's head, a goat's body, and a serpent's tail.
Chimera.motivesAndTactics: Play with food, prowl territory, slay cattle

E7QVs9GBQbV36xWM.name: Rending Jaws
E7QVs9GBQbV36xWM.description: When the @Lookup[@name] makes a successful attack against a PC, the target must mark 2 Armor Slots to reduce the severity by one threshold.

pxSZYIsKirm5mjQc.name: Double Claw
pxSZYIsKirm5mjQc.description: Mark a Stress to make two standard attacks. If both attacks succeed against the same target, combine the damage.

X8V3EFHkGm1G72w2.name: Breath of Fire
X8V3EFHkGm1G72w2.description: Spend a Fear to target up to three PCs in front of the @Lookup[@name] within Close range. Each target must make an Agility Reaction Roll (20). Targets who fail take 3d12 magic damage. Targets who succeed must choose to mark either an Armor Slot or a Stress.

dV6pQgDxmke0KpPH.name: Serpent Strike
dV6pQgDxmke0KpPH.description: When a PC within Close range targets the @Lookup[@name] with an attack, you can mark a Stress to attack the PC first. On a success, deal 4d4+10 physical damage and Poison them until their next rest or they succeed on a Knowledge Roll (20). While Poisoned, the target must roll a d6 before they make an action roll. On a result of 3 or lower, they must mark a Stress.

Qh9Aso9z9OCoKCUO.name: Poisoned
Qh9Aso9z9OCoKCUO.description:
You are Poisoned until your next rest or you succeed on a Knowledge Roll (20).

While Poisoned, you must roll a d6 before they make an action roll. On a result of 3 or lower, they must mark a Stress.

Cipactli.name: Cipactli
Cipactli.description: A gargantuan crocodile that has a body covered in a patchwork of fish scales, toad skin, and dozens of hungry mouths.

6h3DlaZmdtcikM4H.name: Relentless (3)
6h3DlaZmdtcikM4H.description: The @Lookup[@name] can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

LW4JURcTsZzpC5Ay.name: Many Mouths
LW4JURcTsZzpC5Ay.description: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against all targets within Very Close range. Targets the @Lookup[@name] succeeds against must also mark a Stress.

qkWS8NduN1NUBsg9.name: Frenzied Feeding
qkWS8NduN1NUBsg9.description: Spend a Fear to force all PCs within Close range to succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or take 4d6 direct physical damage. The @Lookup[@name] clears a HP for each creature who took Severe damage from this attack.

UGMAHKqr6KGuKx0o.name: Quaking Footfalls
UGMAHKqr6KGuKx0o.description: Mark a Stress to force each PC within Far range to make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail must mark 2 Stress and are Vulnerable until they take damage. Targets who succeed must mark a Stress.

a4e7n4uzB7hHlVyW.name: Lifeblooded
a4e7n4uzB7hHlVyW.description: When the @Lookup[@name] takes Severe damage, its blood splashes to the ground and instantly erupts into a jungle. All creatures within Close range are temporarily Restrained.

FvBoTWCmTlYjRRJU.name: Verdant Explosion
FvBoTWCmTlYjRRJU.description: When the @Lookup[@name] marks its last HP, its body erupts into dense vegetation that overtakes the landscape.

Cloud Titan.name: Cloud Titan
Cloud Titan.description: A devastatingly attractive, blue-skinned goliath dressed in the finest silks and dripping with jewelry. They luxuriate in the finer things and dwell in a sky palace filled with treasure.
Cloud Titan.motivesAndTactics: Acquire rare and valuable things, celebrate beauty, never pass up an interesting wager

Sp222OsLrxhKnqh6.name: Lightning Strike
Sp222OsLrxhKnqh6.description: Mark a Stress to make an attack against a target within Far range. On a success, deal 4d10+14 magic damage and roll a [[/r d6]]. On a result of 4 or higher, the lightning bounces, and the Titan makes this attack against a different target within Very Close range of the previous target. Each time the lightning bounces, decrease the damage it deals by [[/r 1d10]].

T5YGSmbgKztOSs2Z.name: Mist Weaver
T5YGSmbgKztOSs2Z.description: Spend a Fear and choose a point within Far range. The Titan conjures a thick fog over the area within Close range of that point. The Titan is Hidden to enemies within and on the other side of the fog and has advantage on attacks against creatures inside it. The fog lasts until the Titan marks HP.

6X2CCDC4aZtXOovu.name: Nebulous Transformation
6X2CCDC4aZtXOovu.description: Mark a Stress to have the Titan transform into a misty cloud that fills a Very Close area. While in this form, the Titan takes double magic damage and has immunity to physical damage. This form lasts until the Titan chooses to drop out of it or takes Severe damage.

ClprkXZzAmSb1hsb.name: Nebulous
ClprkXZzAmSb1hsb.description: While in this form, the Titan takes double magic damage and has immunity to physical damage. This form lasts until the Titan chooses to drop out of it or takes Severe damage.

i2PdaF37Qm1Xa6mL.name: Unleash the Menagerie
i2PdaF37Qm1Xa6mL.description: Once per scene, mark any number of Stress to summon an equal number of @UUID[Compendium.daggerheart.adversaries.Actor.CJtnIPvyAmv6PFsu]{Griffins}, which appear at Close range.

HhuXSt7z9vfEQi8k.name: Wind Worker
HhuXSt7z9vfEQi8k.description: Spend a Fear to have the Titan blast wind at a target within Close range. The target takes 4d6+8 physical damage and is pushed back to Far range from their current position.

wfgDF0F6enntq5mk.name: Double or Nothing
wfgDF0F6enntq5mk.description: When you would gain a Fear from an attack against the Titan, you can roll a d6. On an odd result, you don't gain the Fear. On an even result, you gain 2 Fear instead of 1.

Common Ruffian.name: Common Ruffian
Common Ruffian.description: A local laborer or artisan pushed by circumstances to assail others.
Common Ruffian.motivesAndTactics: Do violence, seek security and survival

sLpf8vqxOlxYUHZN.name: Group Attack
sLpf8vqxOlxYUHZN.description: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Ruffians within Close range of them. The Ruffians move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 1d8 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

itwtcnEMaOpl4T8K.name: Survival Instinct
itwtcnEMaOpl4T8K.description: When the Ruffian marks half their HP, roll a d6. On a result of 4 or higher, the Ruffian flees the scene. Otherwise, you gain a Fear.

Crimson Lepus.name: Crimson Lepus
Crimson Lepus.description: A red-eyed rabbit that thinks only of murder.
Crimson Lepus.motivesAndTactics: Be cute, go for the throat, hop around

gYRtsPelHA8TvT0K.name: Relentless (3)
gYRtsPelHA8TvT0K.description: The Lepus can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

gS3GnrlC4yBT6hz0.name: "Awww..."
gS3GnrlC4yBT6hz0.description: When the Lepus first appears, it is Too Cute. To attack a Too Cute creature, a PC must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll (20). Clear the Too Cute condition if a PC deals damage to the Lepus or if the Lepus attacks a PC.

WBdDr9lVJ6TtJ0GG.name: Too Cute
WBdDr9lVJ6TtJ0GG.description: A PC must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll (20). Clear the Too Cute condition if a PC deals damage to the Lepus or if the Lepus attacks a PC.

KNHB4gxzIj0S4pS6.name: Terrifying
KNHB4gxzIj0S4pS6.description: When the Lepus makes a successful attack, all PCs within Close range lose a Hope, and you gain a Fear.

vF19a5N2S1OP9Tsr.name: Leaping Jugular Strike
vF19a5N2S1OP9Tsr.description: Spend a Fear to have the Lepus leap into Melee range of a target within Far range and make an attack against them. On a success, deal 3d20 direct physical damage. If the target marks HP from this attack, they become Vulnerable until they clear a HP.

PdLwIohVpnC6phKD.name: Leaping Jugular Strike
PdLwIohVpnC6phKD.description: You are Vulnerable until you clear a HP.

DyFTHR3agasbQMcN.name: Evasive
DyFTHR3agasbQMcN.description: When the Lepus would take damage, roll a d6. On a 4 or higher, halve the damage. If the damage was already halved, the Lepus takes no damage.

4UAcwdFi0ek4DX5l.name: "Run Away!"
4UAcwdFi0ek4DX5l.description: When a PC with no Hope takes the spotlight within Very Far range of the Lepus, the PC must succeed on a Presence Reaction Roll or use their action to flee the battlefield until they spend a Hope to return.

Cryptimoth.name: Cryptimoth
Cryptimoth.description: A large red-eyed moth creature that walks upright and portends mysterious or evil events.
Cryptimoth.motivesAndTactics: Echolocate, fly silently, melt into the shadows

bZcj7Ed3cbLxes8y.name: Terrifying
bZcj7Ed3cbLxes8y.description: When the @Lookup[@name] makes a successful attack, all PCs within Close range lose a Hope, and you gain a Fear.

kQARtKcsiosM7sgA.name: Psychic Screech
kQARtKcsiosM7sgA.description: Spend 2 Fear to have the @Lookup[@name] unleash a burst of psychic energy that causes each PC within Far range to suffer visions of their horrifying fate. Each target must make an Instinct Reaction Roll (16). Targets who fail take 3d8 direct magic damage and become Vulnerable until their next rest. Targets who succeed must mark a Stress or take half damage.

WsK2lZoOA7hyVARG.name: Shadow Swarm
WsK2lZoOA7hyVARG.description: Spend a Fear to have the @Lookup[@name] conjure a swarm of mothlike shadow creatures within Far range. The swarm fills a Close range area and blocks line of sight. Creatures that aren't @Lookup[@name]s are Vulnerable while inside that area and must mark a Stress to move through it. A PC can dispel the swarm with a successful Spellcast Roll (12).

ibGMv1L6QT12LYL9.name: Paranoia Glare
ibGMv1L6QT12LYL9.description: Spend a Fear to have the @Lookup[@name] gaze into the eyes of a PC within Close range and make them Paranoid. While Paranoid, the PC is suspicious of other PCs and can't Help an Ally or take part in Tag Team Rolls. To clear this condition, the PC must succeed on an Insight Roll (16) or participate in the Prepare downtime move with one or more members of their party during a rest.

a7kCdiEj9a5k4WFD.name: Paranoid
a7kCdiEj9a5k4WFD.description: While Paranoid, you are suspicious of other PCs and can't Help an Ally or take part in Tag Team Rolls. To clear this condition, you must succeed on an Insight Roll (16) or participate in the Prepare downtime move with one or more members your party during a rest.

Cursed Merfolk.name: Cursed Merfolk
Cursed Merfolk.description: A half-fish, half-human creature psychically bound to serve the Deep Dwellers.
Cursed Merfolk.motivesAndTactics: Separate enemies, strike from the shadows, use aquatic environment to advantage

qa0hFDclsItQPYVs.name: Fish-Tailed
qa0hFDclsItQPYVs.description: The Merfolk is Vulnerable out of the water.

emz7TWp1nTWNdRYS.name: Fish-Tailed
emz7TWp1nTWNdRYS.description: The Merfolk is Vulnerable out of the water.

ZUgXhnNY23yrVGo8.name: Gang Up
ZUgXhnNY23yrVGo8.description: The Merfolk gains a +2 bonus to attack rolls against targets within Melee range of one or more allies.

Xxca2rzdme37QDbj.name: Gang Up
Xxca2rzdme37QDbj.description: The Merfolk gains a +2 bonus to attack rolls against targets within Melee range of one or more allies.

eX0tAOy7TD4wVgEY.name: "Get Over Here!"
eX0tAOy7TD4wVgEY.description: When the Merfolk makes a successful standard attack against a target beyond Melee range, you can mark a Stress to pull them into Melee range. If you do, you can spend a Fear to make a standard attack with advantage against the target.

Darkweave Crawler.name: Darkweave Crawler
Darkweave Crawler.description: A spider the size of a human head, woven out of shadow-silk.
Darkweave Crawler.motivesAndTactics: Hide in shadow, strike the unwary, wait for an opening

Ll43t7pvzXc4MX8g.name: Minion (3)
Ll43t7pvzXc4MX8g.description: The Crawler is defeated when it takes any damage. For every 3 damage a PC deals to the Crawler, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

M4AppGMZivFZ4Dya.name: Skin-Crawling
M4AppGMZivFZ4Dya.description: Spend a Fear to force all PCs within Melee range of the Crawler to mark a Stress.

TNGpMcO2qZduHGlU.name: Group Attack
TNGpMcO2qZduHGlU.description: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all @Lookup[@name]s within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 2 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

OgB9BlmNPURWYzMI.name: Darkweave Venom
OgB9BlmNPURWYzMI.description: When the Crawler makes a successful attack, you can mark a Stress to Exhaust the target until they succeed on a Strength Roll (9). While Exhausted, the target must mark a Stress each time they make an action roll.

MpyB6TuH8hWbsMco.name: Exhausted
MpyB6TuH8hWbsMco.description: You are Exhausted until you succeed on a Strength Roll (9). While Exhausted, you must mark a Stress each time you make an action roll.

Darkweave Queen.name: Darkweave Queen
Darkweave Queen.description: A wagon-sized spider woven from shadow-silk by a long-forgotten god. Each of her many eyes bears the face of a different victim.
Darkweave Queen.motivesAndTactics: Ambush prey, climb the walls and ceiling, misdirect, paralyze, stash bodies away for later, steal faces

hjIWDp15JpjHjlDl.name: Relentless (3)
hjIWDp15JpjHjlDl.description: The Queen can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight her.

X7Fa0Ur0otImyKGP.name: Den Mother
X7Fa0Ur0otImyKGP.description: Once per scene, spend 2 Fear to summon up to two Darkweave adversaries (other than @Lookup[@name]s), who appear within Close range and immediately take the spotlight.

UMGKSgbSSypytyKF.name: Quicker Than She Looks
UMGKSgbSSypytyKF.description: Spend a Fear to move up to Far range and make a standard attack with advantage.

71yNHGcvRHBXWKVe.name: Darkfang Envenomation
71yNHGcvRHBXWKVe.description: When the Queen succeeds on a standard attack, you can spend a Fear to make the target Vulnerable and Restrained until they succeed on a Strength Roll (12) or take a rest.

uNQLy5UzVzu2CdBS.name: Poisoned
uNQLy5UzVzu2CdBS.description: You are Vulnerable and Restrained until you succeed on a Strength Roll (12) or take a rest.

qMDmnUWx48Dbg7IF.name: Terrifying
qMDmnUWx48Dbg7IF.description: When a PC fails an attack roll against the Queen, you gain a Fear.

Darkweave Spinner.name: Darkweave Spinner
Darkweave Spinner.description: A boar-sized arachnid woven from primordial shadow-silk.

15egsMZB5SaStcBh.name: Wrap in Shadow-Silk
15egsMZB5SaStcBh.description: Mark a Stress to make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, the target is Vulnerable and Restrained until they succeed on a Strength Roll (10).

1f1SHhGdOPjDhswm.name: Wrapped In Silk
1f1SHhGdOPjDhswm.description: You are Vulnerable and Restrained until you succeed on a Strength Roll (10).

c4cCwB00RC5qrOSN.name: Shadow Fang
c4cCwB00RC5qrOSN.description: When the Spinner makes a successful attack against a target within Melee range, you can spend a Fear to make the target Shaky until they succeed on an Instinct Roll (10). While Shaky, the target has disadvantage on attack rolls.

taWTSGGug8ETDBmi.name: Shaky
taWTSGGug8ETDBmi.description: You are Shaky until you succeed on an Instinct Roll (10). While Shaky, you have disadvantage on attack rolls.

Darkweave Swarmlings.name: Darkweave Swarmlings
Darkweave Swarmlings.description: A teeming swarm of tiny spiders woven out of shadow-silk.
Darkweave Swarmlings.motivesAndTactics: Burst out of holes, climb up legs, crawl into ears, scuttle under clothes

5Nd2SDF6BGCabSfk.name: Horde (1d4)
5Nd2SDF6BGCabSfk.description: When the Swarmlings have marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals 1d4 physical damage instead.

ca15rqxQtas4Lx6v.name: "Get 'em Off , Get 'em Off !"
ca15rqxQtas4Lx6v.description: When an attack from the Swarmlings causes a target to mark HP, you can mark a Stress to make the target temporarily Covered in Spiders. While Covered in Spiders, the target must roll a [[/r d6]] when they make an action roll. On a result of 4 or higher, they must mark a Stress or you gain a Fear.

tvjvbMCB20eduOI0.name: Covered In Spiders
tvjvbMCB20eduOI0.description: While Covered in Spiders, you must roll a d6 when you make an action roll. On a result of 4 or higher, you must mark a Stress or the GM gains a Fear.

Deep Dweller.name: Deep Dweller
Deep Dweller.description: A huge psychic lamprey that has pitch-black eyes and toxic tentacles.
Deep Dweller.motivesAndTactics: Abuse power, seek worship, stalk sunken ruins

koabq82mtdwUm0J3.name: Psychic Blast
koabq82mtdwUm0J3.description: Spend a Fear to choose up to three targets within Close range and force them to make an Instinct or Knowledge Reaction Roll. Targets who succeed mark a Stress. Targets who fail take 3d10+4 direct magic damage and are Vulnerable until spotlighted.

EJSZFUchXzCQqGfn.name: Brain Drain
EJSZFUchXzCQqGfn.description: Mark a Stress to choose a Vulnerable PC within Very Close range. The target marks 1d4 Stress, and the @Lookup[@name] clears an equal number of HP.

x7WN5SgJGj1dv4W1.name: Call of the Deep
x7WN5SgJGj1dv4W1.description: Spend 2 Fear to summon 1d4 Cursed Merfolk, who appear at Far range and immediately take the spotlight.

grMlNQ3scZWgkui9.name: Mucosal Contamination
grMlNQ3scZWgkui9.description: Make an attack roll against a PC within Very Close range. On a success, the @Lookup[@name] uses its tentacles to immobilize the target, sliming them with toxic sludge. The target is Restrained until they break free or slip out with a successful Strength or Finesse Roll. Each time the @Lookup[@name] is spotlighted, all PCs Restrained in this way take 3d8 direct physical damage. The @Lookup[@name] releases all creatures Restrained by it when it's defeated or takes Severe damage.

i9QHavOcvqdK8M7R.name: Contaminated
i9QHavOcvqdK8M7R.description: The target is Restrained until they break free or slip out with a successful Strength or Finesse Roll. Each time the Deep Dweller is spotlighted, all PCs Restrained in this way take 3d8 direct physical damage. The Deep Dweller releases all creatures Restrained by it when it's defeated or takes Severe damage.

Demon Lord Berzug.name: Demon Lord Berzug
Demon Lord Berzug.description: The ruler of a deep circle in the Circles Below and a huge hybrid beast with a serpent's tail, a lizard's hind legs, a crab's claw arms, and a two-faced wolf's head.

UXBY3dxa5s9PHD4Z.name: Relentless (3)
UXBY3dxa5s9PHD4Z.description: Berzug can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

F7DSVj7HDXsWPq16.description: Mark a Stress to have Berzug lash at up to three PCs within Close range and force each target to make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 4d20 physical damage. Targets who succeed take half damage.

0INmBdLaQgZu5Q0V.description:
Spend a Fear to have Berzug lock eyes with a PC within Far range. The target must succeed on a Presence Reaction Roll or gain one of the following conditions (roll a d6 and use the corresponding result):

  • 1–2: Mesmerized. The target immediately moves into Melee range of Berzug and is Vulnerable and Restrained until they clear the condition with a successful Instinct Roll.

  • 3–4: Confused. The target must mark a Stress each time they make an action roll until they clear the condition with a successful Knowledge Roll.

  • 5–6: Enthralled. Until the PC makes a successful Presence Roll to clear the condition, you can spotlight them during a GM turn as if they were an adversary. When you do so, choose a target within Close range of the Enthralled PC. The Enthralled PC moves into Melee range of the target and makes a weapon attack against them using a d20 instead of Duality Dice.

Dire Pangolati.name: Dire Pangolati
Dire Pangolati.description: A carriage-sized pangolin-coati hybrid covered in armor plating. It has a bladed tail it uses to fling razor-sharp scales.

When the @Lookup[@name] or duplicate is attacked, the attacker rolls a [[/r d6]]. On an even result, they target the @Lookup[@name]. On an odd result, they target the duplicate, and the attack fails. Dragon Knight.name: Dragon Knight
Dragon Knight.description: A knight clad in dragonplate armor and a helmet in the shape of a dragon's head.
Dragon Knight.motivesAndTactics: Exploit an opening, get some distance, knock enemies off -balance, strike from above

3rM30lvgTyp5NPyx.name: High Ground
3rM30lvgTyp5NPyx.description: The Knight gains advantage on attacks made against targets below them.

qDQbsNq0Rq4OcXoI.name: Leaping Strike
qDQbsNq0Rq4OcXoI.description: Mark a Stress to have the Knight leap into Melee range of a target within Far range and make a standard attack against them. On a success, the attack deals an extra 1d12 damage, and the target must mark an Armor Slot without receiving its benefits (they can still use armor to reduce the damage).

WSKl5y3UKAsQR9np.name: Comeback
WSKl5y3UKAsQR9np.description: When the Knight fails a standard attack, you can spend a Fear to reroll the attack with advantage.

Dragon Mother Mitera.name: Dragon Mother Mitera
Dragon Mother Mitera.description: A gargantuan seven-headed dragon with dazzling diamond scales that shine with every color of the rainbow.
Dragon Mother Mitera.motivesAndTactics: Birth destruction, control the battlefield, fly, repel invaders, use all available options

l9rctm6HcPOyKGsG.name: Relentless (3)

CBxzYJ6yIchg3igO.description: Countdown (7). When Mitera first appears, activate the countdown. Mitera gains a bonus to her Difficulty equal to the countdown die's current value. It ticks down from Mitera's "Seven-Headed" feature. When the countdown triggers, Mitera becomes Vulnerable and gains a +2 bonus to attack rolls.

eh0mvBS3xBn5c4VG.name: Trigger Countdown

ABKEuVoS34ndfCRZ.name: Weakened Hide

xeNAQKBgqiaKJgNR.description:
Mark a Stress to have Mitera unleash elemental energy from one head of your choice:

  1. Fire. Deal 4d12 magic damage to 1d4+1 targets within Close range. Targets who take damage must mark an Armor Slot or 2 additional HP.

  2. Lightning. Deal 4d12 magic damage to 1d6 targets within Far range, so long as each target beyond the first is within Close range of the previous target.

  3. Acid. Each PC in front of Mitera within Close range must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail must mark 2 Armor Slots and 2 HP. Targets who succeed must mark an Armor Slot and a HP.

  4. Poison. A miasma of toxic swamp gas Sickens all targets within Close range of Mitera. While Sickened, a target has disadvantage on action rolls until they mark 1d4 Stress to clear the condition.

  5. Ice. Each target in front of Mitera within Close range takes 4d8+8 magic damage and is Restrained by ice until they break free with a successful Strength Roll. Additionally, this area freezes over and a PC must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll to move through it.

  6. Darkness. A cloud of magical shadow fills an area within Close range. Creatures inside the cloud except for Mitera are Vulnerable and have disadvantage on action rolls that rely on sight. The cloud dissipates when this Elemental Breath option is removed by Mitera's "Seven-Headed" feature.

  7. Light. A beam of pure light energy deals 28 direct magic damage to each creature in a line within Very Far range.

S5VDtif4FxRerSoD.description: When Mitera makes a successful attack roll against a PC or a PC fails a roll within Far range, you gain a Fear.

Drake.name: Drake
Drake.description: A clawed quadruped that has a scaled, serpentine body and a willingness to serve its cousins, the dragons.
Drake.motivesAndTactics: Coil and crush, protect master, slither around lairs and ruins, strike first

HTahWPOKtnN8goRF.description: The @Lookup[@name] can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

Bbr3ZrCKZVkOBA0G.description: When a PC would deal damage to a creature within Close range, you can mark a Stress to have the @Lookup[@name] move to intercept the attack and take the damage instead. Dullahan.name: Dullahan
Dullahan.description: A horse-mounted specter holding their own severed head in one hand and wielding a whip fashioned from a human spine in the other.
Dullahan.motivesAndTactics: Doom with a glance, gallop across water, kick with heavy hooves

BubX3LEWu7RkFj1x.name: Specter
BubX3LEWu7RkFj1x.description: The @Lookup[@name] has resistance to physical damage. Mark a Stress to move up to Close range through solid objects.

nQ3wfwRPPNfXx8ba.name: Dismounted

iQ4jwH7KU0BDLFqL.name: Bone Whip Strike

If the @Lookup[@name] is defeated or the PCs take a rest, all Doom Countdowns end.

retlIReL4PyUzqhV.description: When the @Lookup[@name] makes a successful standard attack, you can spend a Fear to have it toss the target to another location within Close range and deal an extra 1d12 damage.

8hHzmmhOU5Ku81eh.name: Infected

DfogFjl1t860BDII.description: While the Harbinger is on their mount, they gain a +2 bonus to their Difficulty. When the Harbinger takes Severe damage, they're knocked from their mount. If the Harbinger is unhorsed, their mount disappears until you mark a Stress to summon it again.

Qa6H0mZULkyHuQ63.name: Resummon Mount
Qa6H0mZULkyHuQ63.description: When the Harbinger takes Severe damage, they're knocked from their mount. If the Harbinger is unhorsed, their mount disappears until you mark a Stress to summon it again.

lykN2B07hwfFQz3U.name: Mounted
lykN2B07hwfFQz3U.description: While the Harbinger is on their mount, they gain a +2 bonus to their Difficulty.

Harpy.name: Harpy
Harpy.description: A fierce and foul-smelling bird with an eight-foot wingspan and the upper body and face of a human.
Harpy.motivesAndTactics: Defend nest, drop enemies from a great height, maraud from the air, screech incessantly

Lx1ZNmwu5BfS48AD.name: Toxic Aura
Lx1ZNmwu5BfS48AD.description: The @Lookup[@name] emits a foul stench that renders all non-Harpies Vulnerable while within Very Close range.

b1p1GOBQ4VRDKvn6.name: Foul Stench
b1p1GOBQ4VRDKvn6.description: The Harpy emits a foul stench that renders all non-Harpies Vulnerable while within Very Close range.

L4R7Hwu3YKS0ySfl.name: Swooping Attack
L4R7Hwu3YKS0ySfl.description: Mark a Stress to have the @Lookup[@name] move in a straight line to a point within Far range and make an attack against a target in the @Lookup[@name]'s path. On a success, the @Lookup[@name] deals 3d6 physical damage.

Hill Titan.name: Hill Titan
Hill Titan.description: A goliath clad in animal skins and surrounded by a swarm of insects.
Hill Titan.motivesAndTactics: Eat, make a mess, patrol stomping grounds

M0xm1RuRp8RKZ9U2.name: Relentless (3)
M0xm1RuRp8RKZ9U2.description: The Titan can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

4Ujl7ftNG0ZGGRng.name: Gullible
4Ujl7ftNG0ZGGRng.description: PCs have advantage on action rolls to trick or emotionally manipulate the Titan.

kkVrD8dy2HAdNz3a.name: Bug Swarm
kkVrD8dy2HAdNz3a.description: PCs are Vulnerable while within Very Close range.

Xgwos3c1kvGSl9yu.name: Mighty Swing
Xgwos3c1kvGSl9yu.description: Spend a Fear to make a standard attack against all targets within Very Close range.

OdMvmwBr3mD0gwaL.name: Momentum
OdMvmwBr3mD0gwaL.description: When the Titan makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

Hive Walker.name: Hive Walker
Hive Walker.description: A corpse filled with and puppeted by a colony of carrion-eating bees.
Hive Walker.motivesAndTactics: Encase prey in honey, protect the hive

h2aCJ7Beoel7DHW5.name: Blood Honey
h2aCJ7Beoel7DHW5.description: The Walker disgorges thick crimson honey at all targets between it and a point within Close range. Each target in that line must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or take 2d8 magic damage and become temporarily Restrained as the honey hardens on them.

EuyZSYnaWCLvPoKU.name: Bee-Ruption
EuyZSYnaWCLvPoKU.description: When the Walker marks HP, vengeful bees erupt from its body to protect it. Each target within Very Close range must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or take 1d8 direct physical damage for each HP the @Lookup[@name] has marked. Restrained targets automatically fail the reaction roll.

Jack-o'-lantern.name: Jack-o'-lantern
Jack-o'-lantern.description: A floating pumpkin or other gourd that has a face carved into it. The soul trapped within it emits an eerie glow.
Jack-o'-lantern.motivesAndTactics: Bite, float, laugh, tell spooky stories

btKRKx9UWRN2crN1.name: Minion (4)
btKRKx9UWRN2crN1.description: The @Lookup[@name] is defeated when it takes any damage. For every 4 damage a PC deals to the Jack-o'- Lantern, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

Gs8ZHt8BGz7NHOwq.name: Group Attack
Gs8ZHt8BGz7NHOwq.description: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all @Lookup[@name]s within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 6 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

A4L1b024r7OrZvkx.name: Spine-Chilling Cackle
A4L1b024r7OrZvkx.description: When a PC within Very Close range rolls with Fear, you can mark a Stress to gain an additional Fear.

Kelpie.name: Kelpie
Kelpie.description: A river-dwelling shapeshifter who prefers an enchanting equine form in and out of the water.
Kelpie.motivesAndTactics: Adopt an attractive or useful shape, drown and devour, entice unwary travelers

GWoZeTvWRz31pKP3.name: Captivating
GWoZeTvWRz31pKP3.description: A PC must mark a Stress to move out of the @Lookup[@name]'s Melee range.

PxihMdsvGEScJiJZ.name: Heart's Desire
PxihMdsvGEScJiJZ.description: After the @Lookup[@name] interacts with or watches a creature for at least a hundred heartbeats, the @Lookup[@name] knows the physical form that creature would find most pleasing or alluring.

vJ9gupJ0Hmya1o47.name: Shapeshifter
vJ9gupJ0Hmya1o47.description: Mark a Stress to change the @Lookup[@name]'s physical form into any creature or object smaller than a wagon. A creature has disadvantage on rolls against the @Lookup[@name] while the @Lookup[@name] is in a form the creature finds pleasing or alluring.

c4uXzgVzI95IC7aR.name: Enchant
c4uXzgVzI95IC7aR.description: Spend a Fear to have the @Lookup[@name] beguile a PC within Close range. The PC must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or become Enchanted until they take damage. While Enchanted, the PC perceives the @Lookup[@name] as a trusted friend or ally and will do what the @Lookup[@name] says unless it contradicts the PC's most deeply held morals.

IfIZYI225LzuJNNK.name: Enchanted
IfIZYI225LzuJNNK.description: You perceive the Kelpie as a trusted friend or ally and will do what the Kelpie says unless it contradicts your most deeply held morals.

Lamia.name: Lamia
Lamia.description: A snake-tailed humanoid monster who stalks the night to absorb the life energy of sleeping people.
Lamia.motivesAndTactics: Attack the unaware, avoid sunlight, leech life force, put to sleep, slither through tall grass

bkNqFMvqT2qnOH9E.name: Constriction
bkNqFMvqT2qnOH9E.description: Mark a Stress to have the @Lookup[@name] wrap their tail around a PC within Melee range and squeeze. The target must succeed on a Finesse Reaction Roll or become Constricted until the @Lookup[@name] moves or takes Major or greater damage. While Constricted, the target is Restrained and must mark a Stress when the @Lookup[@name] takes the spotlight.

d5RIO2p6SFAXz7Qp.name: Constricted
d5RIO2p6SFAXz7Qp.description:
You are Constricted until the Lamia moves or takes Major or greater damage.

While Constricted, the target is Restrained and must mark a Stress when the Lamia takes the spotlight.

NC3gWjQQFXqjCYrg.name: Life Leech
NC3gWjQQFXqjCYrg.description: Mark a Stress to force a Vulnerable or Restrained target within Melee range to mark 1d4-1 HP. The @Lookup[@name] then clears an equal number of HP.

PPji2Wiib7ixf30i.name: Sleep Toxin
PPji2Wiib7ixf30i.description: When the @Lookup[@name] makes a successful standard attack against a PC, you can spend a Fear to make them Vulnerable until they succeed on a Instinct Roll (19).

5unIqJr52ZzFDvbg.name: Drowzy
5unIqJr52ZzFDvbg.description: You are Vulnerable until they succeed on a Instinct Roll (19).

Lamplight Beguiler.name: Lamplight Beguiler
Lamplight Beguiler.description: A huge aquatic creature that lures unwary prey into eating range with its dangling, shapeshifting head stalk.
Lamplight Beguiler.motivesAndTactics: Entice with secret knowledge, snap the trap shut, speak through a shapeshifted head stalk

rD4dK5rbkMggavMU.name: Doppel-Dangler
rD4dK5rbkMggavMU.description: The membranous cluster at the end of the Beguiler's head stalk can shapeshift into any humanoid form. Mark a Stress to choose a PC within Close range. Their player must tell you who their PC would find most trustworthy. The Beguiler's head stalk transforms into that person and gains the ability to speak in their voice.

Znw9Vf9GrfXm6g8N.name: Doppel-Dangler
Znw9Vf9GrfXm6g8N.description: Their player must tell you who their PC would find most trustworthy. The Beguiler's head stalk transforms into that person and gains the ability to speak in their voice.

nbzoUABWDwUdGkFE.name: Entice
nbzoUABWDwUdGkFE.description: Spend a Fear to have the Beguiler make an alluring overture to a PC within Close range. The PC must succeed on a Presence Reaction Roll (18) or move into Melee range with the Beguiler. If the Beguiler's head stalk is transformed into a person the PC would find trustworthy, they have disadvantage on the reaction roll.

XDqv8pIUqp8LW0Sh.name: Gulp
XDqv8pIUqp8LW0Sh.description: When a PC moves within Melee range, you can spend a Fear to make an attack roll against them. On a successful attack, the target takes 3d6 physical damage and is Swallowed. While Swallowed, the target is Restrained and takes 3d6 physical damage when the Beguiler takes the spotlight. The Beguiler disgorges all Swallowed creatures when it takes Major or Severe damage.

JfAXMYK3fSKste6M.name: Swallowed
JfAXMYK3fSKste6M.description: While Swallowed, the target is Restrained and takes 3d6 physical damage when the Beguiler takes the spotlight. The Beguiler disgorges all Swallowed creatures when it takes Major or Severe damage.

Landshark.name: Landshark
Landshark.description: A quadrupedal shark that swims through the ground.
Landshark.motivesAndTactics: Burrow, burst out of the ground, circle prey

llcjO2P9jqrhl5vr.name: Burrowing
llcjO2P9jqrhl5vr.description: The @Lookup[@name] can move through the ground as easily as over it. When the @Lookup[@name] moves, it can choose to burrow or surface. While underground, the @Lookup[@name] has resistance to all damage but can't attack.

AdpTMp82XSHhGUDA.name: Burrowed
AdpTMp82XSHhGUDA.description: While underground, the Landshark has resistance to all damage but can't attack.

JQcVefx6fpSoa9Rd.name: Thick-Skinned
JQcVefx6fpSoa9Rd.description: When the @Lookup[@name] would be forced to mark any number of HP, you can mark an equal number of Stress instead.

BikRG1s59ZXky7V6.name: Rending Chomp
BikRG1s59ZXky7V6.description: When the @Lookup[@name] makes a successful attack against a PC within Melee range, you can spend a Fear to force the target to mark an Armor Slot without receiving its benefits (they can still use armor to reduce the damage).

Landshark Behemoth.name: Landshark Behemoth
Landshark Behemoth.description: A landshark that's lived long enough to become a large burrowing monstrosity with steely hide and razor-sharp teeth.
Landshark Behemoth.motivesAndTactics: Bite, burrow, burst out of the ground

suP10DxENd9ZLfss.name: Relentless (3)
suP10DxENd9ZLfss.description: The Behemoth can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

2tZhGrctXW7d3Wn5.name: Deep Diver
2tZhGrctXW7d3Wn5.description: The Behemoth can move through the ground as easily as over it. When the Behemoth moves, it can choose to burrow or surface. While underground, the Behemoth is immune to damage but can't attack.

uHZW0M3vlRNFppzI.name: Deep Diver
uHZW0M3vlRNFppzI.description: While underground, the Behemoth is immune to damage but can't attack.

mv1UXfyCZ1inA58c.name: Steel-Skinned
mv1UXfyCZ1inA58c.description: All damage dealt to the Behemoth is reduced by one threshold.

pMlW6q8CzYzTDBls.name: Steel Skinned
pMlW6q8CzYzTDBls.description: All damage dealt to the Behemoth is reduced by one threshold.

j1mUnngeA5NKBgnZ.name: Forceful Eruption
j1mUnngeA5NKBgnZ.description: The Behemoth erupts from the ground, forcing each PC within Very Close range to succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or be knocked over, becoming Vulnerable until they make an action roll. For each PC made Vulnerable in this way, you gain a Fear.

qc2utRaB2sLvGCv0.name: Knocked Over
qc2utRaB2sLvGCv0.description: You are Vulnerable until you make an action roll

Manticore.name: Manticore
Manticore.description: A legendary beast that has a human's face, lion's body, scorpion's tail, and dragon's wings.
Manticore.motivesAndTactics: Bite, claw, pounce, riddle, swipe, swoop, trick

qsUUBZt6od9imXhv.name: Relentless (3)
qsUUBZt6od9imXhv.description: The @Lookup[@name] can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

ENHHj25Jmzwl8oKn.name: Riddle Me This
ENHHj25Jmzwl8oKn.description: The @Lookup[@name] is obsessed with puzzles and can be distracted by brain teasers, word games, or other semi-intellectual diversions.

zqDrfCZDk8qNPBSn.name: Winged
zqDrfCZDk8qNPBSn.description: While airborne, the @Lookup[@name] gains a +2 bonus to their Difficulty and attack rolls.

ohIpDGlDSw6m1QED.name: Flying
ohIpDGlDSw6m1QED.description: While airborne, the Manticore gains a +2 bonus to their Difficulty and attack rolls.

DtEHBkdcv6z3q7x9.name: Pouncing Attack
DtEHBkdcv6z3q7x9.description: Spend a Fear to have the @Lookup[@name] pounce into Melee range of a target within Far range and make an attack against them. On a success, deal 3d20+6 physical damage, and the target becomes Shaky until they spend a Hope. While Shaky, the target makes attack rolls with disadvantage.

Y51fFtW8cqVu0uM1.name: Shaky
Y51fFtW8cqVu0uM1.description: You are Shaky until you spend a Hope. While Shaky, you make attack rolls with disadvantage.

JkAUCfodIaav6mp2.name: Paralyzing Tail Spike
JkAUCfodIaav6mp2.description: Mark a Stress to make an attack roll against a target within Close range. On a success, the target takes 3d8 physical damage and becomes Restrained until they overcome the toxin with a successful Strength Roll.

wxgYIxwQHUMCaU1E.name: Paralyzed
wxgYIxwQHUMCaU1E.description: You are Restrained until you overcome the toxin with a successful Strength Roll.

jKieOD0PkBx38aQS.name: Locking Jaws
jKieOD0PkBx38aQS.description: When the @Lookup[@name] succeeds on a standard attack against a target within Melee range, you can mark a Stress to lock their jaws onto the target, making the target Restrained and Vulnerable until they escape with a successful Strength Roll (19).

wCyKJfNQTx2a62Di.name: Trapped
wCyKJfNQTx2a62Di.description: You are Restrained and Vulnerable until you escape with a successful Strength Roll (19).

Masque Muerte.name: Masque Muerte
Masque Muerte.description: The raging soul of a villainous masked wrestler.
Masque Muerte.motivesAndTactics: Call out, embarrass, energize the audience, pin opponents to the ground

6o1xTsu1ujGrfABq.name: Heel Turn
6o1xTsu1ujGrfABq.description: Mark a Stress to make an attack against a PC within Close range. On a success, the target must mark a Stress and is temporarily Vulnerable as the @Lookup[@name] assaults them with a string of insulting taunts.

lPJq72e93dc2ODK3.name: Spectral Suplex
lPJq72e93dc2ODK3.description: Spend a Fear to have the @Lookup[@name] suplex a Restrained PC, dealing 1d10+6 magic damage to them.

NPoRVKRQzuLUw0mM.name: Unmasking Death
NPoRVKRQzuLUw0mM.description: Spend a Fear to have the @Lookup[@name] momentarily remove their mask, revealing their horrifying face underneath. Each PC within Close range must succeed on a Presence Reaction Roll or mark a Stress.

pR9baknxxTOr3Vbb.name: Tag Team
pR9baknxxTOr3Vbb.description: When the @Lookup[@name] deals damage to a PC, you can spend a Fear to have a spectral wrestler appear and Pin the target until they escape with a successful Strength Roll. While Pinned, the target is Restrained and takes an extra 1d12 magic damage from the @Lookup[@name]'s attacks.

g1W6cRSGVSteu99P.name: Pinned
g1W6cRSGVSteu99P.description: You are Pinned until you escape with a successful Strength Roll. While Pinned, you are Restrained and take an extra 1d12 magic damage from the Masque Muerte's attacks.

Mechanorb.name: Mechanorb
Mechanorb.description: A floating clockwork sphere that has telescoping limbs and comes from a realm of machines and metal.
Mechanorb.motivesAndTactics: Coordinate, (dis)assemble, move orthogonally, speak in binary

nGj2O5gEwfZWJyYi.name: Hive Mind
nGj2O5gEwfZWJyYi.description: The @Lookup[@name] gains a +1 bonus to their Difficulty for each other @Lookup[@name] within Close range.

r2jnaUwHvPBQKDmg.name: Adaptive Tactics
r2jnaUwHvPBQKDmg.description: Pool. When the @Lookup[@name] fails an attack roll, add a token to the @Lookup[@name] Pool. All @Lookup[@name]s in the scene gain a bonus to attack rolls equal to the number of tokens in the @Lookup[@name] Pool. Clear all tokens when any @Lookup[@name] takes Severe damage or is defeated.

Mountain Troll.name: Mountain Troll
Mountain Troll.description: A hideous giant born out of a massive rock. They wear purloined armor and a belt of severed heads or skulls.
Mountain Troll.motivesAndTactics: Ambush, bellow, hurl large boulders, smash, stomp

RWMgJTJU5adTtpXS.name: Relentless (3)
RWMgJTJU5adTtpXS.description: The Troll can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

3xBKHT3vHPmXoIDH.name: Stolen Armor
3xBKHT3vHPmXoIDH.description: Countdown. When combat begins, activate a countdown with a value equal to the number of PCs. When the Troll takes damage, reduce the severity by one threshold, then tick down the countdown. When it triggers, the Troll evolves (see "Enraged @Lookup[@name]").

IeHRd0HSjeDWmMkB.name: Stolen Armor
IeHRd0HSjeDWmMkB.description: When the Troll takes damage, reduce the severity by one threshold.

W0YS8rMhgEQQMFRF.name: Flail Swipe
W0YS8rMhgEQQMFRF.description: Mark a Stress to make an attack against all targets in front of the Troll within Very Close range. Targets the Troll succeeds against take 2d8+2 physical damage.

c89I2BlpU2nQyWji.name: Enraged Mountain Troll
c89I2BlpU2nQyWji.description: The Troll loses their "Stolen Armor" and "Flail Swipe" features, then gains a +1 bonus to their Difficulty. Additionally, they gain the "Double Swipe" feature and replace "Skull Flail" with the following standard attack: Claw Swipe: Very Close | 1d10+3 phy.

7D0zNvZQ6H8srwEo.name: Enraged
7D0zNvZQ6H8srwEo.description: The Troll loses their "Stolen Armor" and "Flail Swipe" features, then gains a +1 bonus to their Difficulty. Additionally, they gain the "Double Swipe" feature and replace "Skull Flail" with the following standard attack: Claw Swipe: Very Close | 1d10+3 phy.

tOz9yigrsPXyrPiK.name: Double Swipe
tOz9yigrsPXyrPiK.description: Spend a Fear to move up to Close range and make two standard attacks against a target within Melee range. If both attacks succeed, combine the damage, and the target loses a Hope.

Night Children.name: Night Children
Night Children.description: A teeming assortment of nocturnal fiends under the thrall of an ancient evil.
Night Children.motivesAndTactics: Carry victims back to master, overrun settlements, slither through shadow

ucFcfRizVkPT0w9m.name: Horde (2d6+2)
ucFcfRizVkPT0w9m.description: When the @Lookup[@name] have marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals 2d6+2 physical damage instead.

SAbm4NER4YEtrGTG.name: Swell Ranks
SAbm4NER4YEtrGTG.description: Once per scene, mark any number of Stress to have the @Lookup[@name] open a portal that spews forth reinforcements, refilling the Horde's ranks. Clear a number of HP equal to the number of Stress marked.

eXVZweQ7AoZgWMbG.name: Overwhelm
eXVZweQ7AoZgWMbG.description: When the @Lookup[@name] mark HP from an attack within Melee range, you can mark a Stress to make a standard attack against the attacker.

Octopus.name: Octopus
Octopus.description: An aquatic, soft-bodied mollusk that has eight sucker-bearing arms and a hard, beaklike jaw.
Octopus.motivesAndTactics: Crawl along the ocean floor, eat fish, squirt ink to escape

JEsOYtkNPrEjQp9A.name: Grapple
JEsOYtkNPrEjQp9A.description: Make an attack roll against a target within Close range. On a success, the target becomes Restrained and Vulnerable until they escape with a successful Strength Roll.

dxVvOg6fPXjXKvix.name: Grappled
dxVvOg6fPXjXKvix.description: You are Restrained and Vulnerable until you escape with a successful Strength Roll.

bw3GFtQ9rdOOmaNs.name: Squirt Ink
bw3GFtQ9rdOOmaNs.description: Mark a Stress to have the @Lookup[@name] squirt ink. On land, the ink covers the ground within Very Close range. Each creature who moves through that area must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or slip and fall, becoming Vulnerable until they exit the area. If this feature is used while the @Lookup[@name] is underwater, it instead creates a cloud of darkness that fills an area within Very Close range and blocks line of sight.

jr87zJpDybbRCE3f.name: Slipped
jr87zJpDybbRCE3f.description: You are Vulnerable until you exit the area of the ink.

Owl Witch.name: Owl Witch
Owl Witch.description: A giant, vengeful barn owl that has a 15-foot wingspan and a human face.

oiBhMfUNn9bCEdmX.name: Ill Omen
oiBhMfUNn9bCEdmX.description: When a PC within Close range makes an action roll, their Fear Die gains a bonus equal to the amount of Fear you have.

hd02VKqWhG2Uu0t8.name: Witch Barrier
hd02VKqWhG2Uu0t8.description: The Owl Witch has resistance to magic damage.

SDq4QlTBkrX0v5mZ.name: Voice Mimicry
SDq4QlTBkrX0v5mZ.description: Spend a Fear to have the @Lookup[@name] beckon with the voice of a beloved figure to a creature within earshot. The target must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or move up to Far range toward the @Lookup[@name].

JQ0bdv1Gnb0VD4Gm.name: Nightmare Stare
JQ0bdv1Gnb0VD4Gm.description: Spend a Fear to have the @Lookup[@name] Afflict a PC within Far range with waking nightmares unless the target succeeds on a Knowledge Reaction Roll. While Afflicted, the target can't clear HP or Stress. The condition is cleared when another PC uses a downtime move to comfort the Afflicted creature.

0tULtmVqDsZR60oh.name: Afflicted
0tULtmVqDsZR60oh.description: While Afflicted, you can't clear HP or Stress. The condition is cleared when another PC uses a downtime move to comfort you.

0gsas3oxit5vgG8C.name: Visions of a Violent End
0gsas3oxit5vgG8C.description: When the @Lookup[@name] is targeted by an attack, you can spend a Fear to force the attacker to make a Presence Reaction Roll. On a failure, they must mark 1d4 Stress as their mind is flooded with harrowing imagery.

Pain Priest.name: Pain Priest
Pain Priest.description: A member of an other-dimensional religious order devoted to exploring the boundaries of mortal suff ering and ecstasy.
Pain Priest.motivesAndTactics: Feed on emotions, locate the innocent or curious, tempt them with their deepest desires

3OcaZ6mn5hJSqb4g.name: Walk Between Worlds
3OcaZ6mn5hJSqb4g.description: Mark a Stress to place the Priest anywhere within Very Far range and immediately spotlight them again.

8Jbhoixqt3Bw1i2H.name: Pleasure and Pain
8Jbhoixqt3Bw1i2H.description: When a PC within Close range of the Priest gains a Hope or marks HP, roll a d8. On a result of 8, the Priest opens a portal to their original dimension and flees there with the closest party member. You gain 1d6 Fear. The portal remains open until the Priest is defeated or spotlighted again.

Panther.name: Panther
Panther.description: A large feline predator that stalks its prey from the shadows.

HnRyZMTu3m5nalo3.name: Shadow Stalker
HnRyZMTu3m5nalo3.description: While Hidden, the @Lookup[@name] gains a +2 bonus to its attack rolls.

GDZDLLpRtBvG8F18.name: Shadow Stalker
GDZDLLpRtBvG8F18.description: While Hidden, gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls.

A9OTgQABHnrtpINC.name: Pouncing Strike
A9OTgQABHnrtpINC.description: Mark a Stress to have the @Lookup[@name] leap into Melee range of a target within Far range and make an attack against them. On a success, deal 1d12+2 physical damage.

Phantom.name: Phantom
Phantom.description: The echo of a lost soul in the form of an ectoplasmic shadow.
Phantom.motivesAndTactics: Create cold spots, swoop through the air, whisper dark tidings

8X2Jv3VVwXPkt73H.name: Incorporeal
8X2Jv3VVwXPkt73H.description: The @Lookup[@name] has resistance to physical damage and can move through solid objects.

u1wlbCuZ56HTJrIZ.name: Incorporeal
u1wlbCuZ56HTJrIZ.description: The Phantom has resistance to physical damage and can move through solid objects.

M8DGdeEjEqjiwhfs.name: Fear Aura
M8DGdeEjEqjiwhfs.description: A PC who takes the spotlight within Very Close range of the @Lookup[@name] must succeed on a Presence Reaction Roll (10) or mark a Stress.

fjvRO8QadG5kFWV7.name: Lingering Haunt
fjvRO8QadG5kFWV7.description: Countdown (1d6). When the @Lookup[@name] is defeated, you can spend a Fear to activate the countdown. It ticks down when a PC rolls with Fear. When it triggers, clear the @Lookup[@name]'s HP and immediately spotlight them.

eLEuZWbjMcwd1Zw5.name: Trigger Countdown
eLEuZWbjMcwd1Zw5.description: When it triggers, clear the @Lookup[@name]'s HP and immediately spotlight them.

Phoenix.name: Phoenix
Phoenix.description: A huge eagle that's made of magical flame, impossible to kill, and hunted for its healing plumage.
Phoenix.motivesAndTactics: Flee pursuers, live brilliantly, soar through the heavens, wield light and flame

YOEWBnOR44OHkdQe.name: Purifying Aura
YOEWBnOR44OHkdQe.description: Any PC who takes an action within the @Lookup[@name]'s Melee range can spend a Hope to purify themself in its healing warmth, clearing a HP or a Stress and all conditions.

FlcR2XWYcCedfLnM.name: Fireseed
FlcR2XWYcCedfLnM.description: The @Lookup[@name] bleeds magic fire. When the @Lookup[@name] marks a HP, summon one Minor Fire Elemental within Very Close range.

L1KzwZQAUDJzEFv0.name: Resurrection
L1KzwZQAUDJzEFv0.description: When the @Lookup[@name] is defeated, it becomes a cloud of ash that blows away to reveal a Smoldering Egg. The Egg is immune to all damage and has a heat aura that deals 3d4 direct magic damage to anyone who touches it. The Egg hatches into a new @Lookup[@name], with all HP and Stress cleared, in 7 days.

xJGxzVJTPEDpzAVG.name: Ressurecting
xJGxzVJTPEDpzAVG.description: The Egg is immune to all damage and has a heat aura that deals 3d4 direct magic damage to anyone who touches it. The Egg hatches into a new Phoenix, with all HP and Stress cleared, in 7 days.

Plesiosaurus.name: Plesiosaurus
Plesiosaurus.description: A canoe-length marine lizard that has a long neck and four flippers.
Plesiosaurus.motivesAndTactics: Dive deeper, eat fish, swim peacefully

u1kUGcAPZGXfCTmT.name: Only a Rumor
u1kUGcAPZGXfCTmT.description: While deep underwater, the @Lookup[@name] can't be located or targeted.

iGIVBeuyJDKftzrs.name: Wall of Water
iGIVBeuyJDKftzrs.description: Mark a Stress to have the @Lookup[@name] breach and crash, sending a wall of water from one side of its body. Each PC within Far range on that side of the @Lookup[@name] must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll (18) or take 3d10 physical damage and be pushed back to Far range.

Poltergeist.name: Poltergeist
Poltergeist.description: A baleful, translucent spirit that possesses inanimate objects.
Poltergeist.motivesAndTactics: Flicker candles, rattle chains, shake windows, throw people around the room

46MnCFburOGkFfxC.name: Specter
46MnCFburOGkFfxC.description: The @Lookup[@name] has resistance to physical damage. Mark a Stress to move up to Close range through solid objects.

rzekN1tGVLzsnrcZ.name: Mark Stress
rzekN1tGVLzsnrcZ.description: Mark a Stress to move up to Close range through solid objects.

TG5Mkvcvw1JzCnoX.name: Specter
TG5Mkvcvw1JzCnoX.description: The Poltergeist has resistance to physical damage.

UugDye75RdeNZw37.name: Possessor
UugDye75RdeNZw37.description: Mark a Stress to have the @Lookup[@name] inhabit a nonmagical object that is entirely within Close range, infusing the object with a ghostly glow. The next time the @Lookup[@name] would take damage, the object is destroyed instead, and the @Lookup[@name] is expelled from it.

qX9bmAPqLAU7jhN6.name: Possessing Object
qX9bmAPqLAU7jhN6.description: The next time the Poltergeist would take damage, the object is destroyed instead, and the Poltergeist is expelled from it.

sQEVdFOtGR0EEjrM.name: Ghost Storm
sQEVdFOtGR0EEjrM.description: Spend a Fear to have the @Lookup[@name] pull all unequipped nonmagical objects within Very Close range into a violent vortex. Each target in that area must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 1d12+2 physical damage. Targets who succeed take half damage.

Rabble Mawb.name: Rabble Mawb
Rabble Mawb.description: These cat-sized balls of hair, limbs, and teeth travel in a "mawb" of a dozen.
Rabble Mawb.motivesAndTactics: Chitter and chew, clump together, roll around

bLv6g1Lj3ygaemXp.name: Horde (1d4+1)
bLv6g1Lj3ygaemXp.description: When the @Lookup[@name] has marked half or more of its HP, its standard attack deals 1d4+1 physical damage instead.

jC4ngCoNcUSTuJv9.name: Come Back Worse
jC4ngCoNcUSTuJv9.description: When the @Lookup[@name] is defeated, you can spend a Fear to bring it back to life, clearing all HP and Stress. The @Lookup[@name] gains a bonus to all rolls equal to the number of times this feature has been used by this @Lookup[@name].

jsSpZ9WaB1NdAhO4.name: Came Back Worse
jsSpZ9WaB1NdAhO4.description: The Rabble Mawb gains a bonus to all rolls equal to the number of times this feature has been used by this Rabble Mawb.

iLgfMc5nYu56Cgqa.name: Came Back Worse
iLgfMc5nYu56Cgqa.description: The Rabble Mawb gains a bonus to all rolls equal to the number of times this feature has been used by this Rabble Mawb.

Ravenous Mockery.name: Ravenous Mockery
Ravenous Mockery.description: A shapeshifting predator that assumes the appearance of inanimate objects to lure unwary prey into its threat range.
Ravenous Mockery.motivesAndTactics: Ambush, lie in wait, swallow without chewing, take on an unassuming shape

rn2adeYuqdaHFD0v.name: Tongue Attack
rn2adeYuqdaHFD0v.description: Mark a Stress to attack a creature within Close range. On a success, the target is pulled into Melee range with the Mockery and Restrained until they escape with a successful Strength Roll, and you can spend a Fear to activate the Mockery's Devour feature against the target.

6Jfy2dcM2AByqzE1.name: Grabbed
6Jfy2dcM2AByqzE1.description: You are Restrained until you escape with a successful Strength Roll

G1qVvL0l6KKd7sTs.name: Devour
G1qVvL0l6KKd7sTs.description: Attack a target within Melee range. On a success, the Mockery Swallows the target. While Swallowed, the target is Restrained and marks a HP when the Mockery is spotlighted. The Mockery disgorges all Swallowed creatures when it takes Major or Severe damage.

TgY8vZ5fm8EwOaRU.name: Swallowed
TgY8vZ5fm8EwOaRU.description: You are Restrained and must mark a HP whenever the Mockery is spotlighted.

i2G6IPeYPxI5Yex6.name: Never Just One
i2G6IPeYPxI5Yex6.description: Spend a Fear to reveal that another object on the battlefield has been a @Lookup[@name] the whole time, then immediately spotlight it.

Redcap Biters.name: Redcap Biters
Redcap Biters.description: A troop of fist-sized fey creatures who have needle-sharp teeth and conical red caps sealed on their heads with candle wax.
Redcap Biters.motivesAndTactics: Bring 'em down, celebrate tiny victories, giggle and chitter, scamper between the walls

f0Ln9gu04NjQKiGf.name: Horde (1d4+2)
f0Ln9gu04NjQKiGf.description: When the Biters have marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals 1d4+2 physical damage instead.

m1iwZJ8vLcN7LPei.name: Ankle Weights
m1iwZJ8vLcN7LPei.description: A PC must mark a Stress to move out of the Biters' Melee range.

Redcap Breaker.name: Redcap Breaker
Redcap Breaker.description: A large, brutish fey creature who has a conical red cap sealed on their head with candle wax.
Redcap Breaker.motivesAndTactics: Beat chest and bellow, ragdoll puny enemies, rush forward recklessly

7Hb61RwIDV2By15p.name: Backbreaker
7Hb61RwIDV2By15p.description: Mark a Stress to make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 3d4+10 physical damage. A target who marks HP from this attack is Restrained until they clear a HP.

MovoV21E6v5WRgw9.name: Broken Back
MovoV21E6v5WRgw9.description: You are Restrained until you clear a HP.

TLhieXiU5Sy4TOy1.name: Kneecapper
TLhieXiU5Sy4TOy1.description: When the Breaker makes a successful standard attack, you can spend a Fear to make the target temporarily Vulnerable.

Redcap Butcher.name: Redcap Butcher
Redcap Butcher.description: A halfling-sized fey creature who hacks their victims apart with a variety of cutting implements. They wear a conical red hat sealed on their head with candle wax.
Redcap Butcher.motivesAndTactics: Grin disconcertingly, hack and slash, scramble

wsHCq553WEQTApjJ.name: Chop Happy
wsHCq553WEQTApjJ.description: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against up to three targets. For each target who marks HP, you gain a Fear.

gerrZLjFJnjkHGtu.name: Knife Thrower
gerrZLjFJnjkHGtu.description: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against a target within Far range. If the Butcher is Hidden, they make the attack with advantage.

Redcap Candlemaker.name: Redcap Candlemaker
Redcap Candlemaker.description: A pale, gaunt cult leader wearing a conical red cap sealed on their head with candle wax. They wield a long rod with a candle atop it made from a hanged criminal's hand.
Redcap Candlemaker.motivesAndTactics: Cast long shadows, keep out of the fray, show them the light

ogvPI7cMbJiw9fOp.name: Hand of Glory
ogvPI7cMbJiw9fOp.description: When the Candlemaker appears, place 5 tokens on this stat block. Remove a token whenever the Candlemaker marks a HP. While this stat block has 1 or more tokens on it, the Candlemaker is Hidden.

ROVFeyrE1kkZ4Vou.name: Hand Of Glory
ROVFeyrE1kkZ4Vou.description: While this stat block has 1 or more tokens on it, the Candlemaker is Hidden.

oAQweBSYwOqJ3fEx.name: Torchbearer
oAQweBSYwOqJ3fEx.description: The light of the Candlemaker's Hand of Glory inspires bloodlust in their allies. While this stat block has 1 or more tokens on it, each Redcap adversary within Close range gains a +1 bonus to their damage rolls.

FRS0L5U1v6w72yju.name: Torchbearer
FRS0L5U1v6w72yju.description: While this stat block has 1 or more tokens on it, each Redcap adversary within Close range gains a +1 bonus to their damage rolls.

tNNiTGb8aRB511zm.name: Dance in the Flames
tNNiTGb8aRB511zm.description: Spend a token from this stat block. The Candlemaker conjures a ball of fire on a group of PCs within Far range. Each target must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 2d10 magic damage. Targets who succeed take half damage.

Redcap Skinner.name: Redcap Skinner
Redcap Skinner.description: A cat-sized fey creature wielding a straight razor and wearing a conical red cap sealed on their head with candle wax.

Mgkt4CpQBU2OyWmz.name: Minion (4)
Mgkt4CpQBU2OyWmz.description: The Skinner is defeated when they take any damage. For every 4 damage a PC deals to the Skinner, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

jaLGm9PxB6KvVTlI.name: Shallow Cuts
jaLGm9PxB6KvVTlI.description: When a PC fails a roll, they take 1 physical damage for each Skinner within Melee range of them. Combine this damage.

6nEBkyA013PMWpGj.name: Group Attack
6nEBkyA013PMWpGj.description: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all @Lookup[@name]s within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 2 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

Roc.name: Roc
Roc.description: A giant falcon that nests in the mountains and unleashes storms.
Roc.motivesAndTactics: Breathe lightning and speak thunder, protect eggs, rake with talons, spy from afar

Mt5D5PIH7hNVid4I.name: Relentless (3)
Mt5D5PIH7hNVid4I.description: The @Lookup[@name] can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

SvtXB2X6a8abxxpB.name: Bird of Prey
SvtXB2X6a8abxxpB.description: Once per GM turn, the @Lookup[@name] can move up to Very Far range before or after it takes an action.

JHpHvFvrJGI2Kwe1.name: Here Comes the Boom
JHpHvFvrJGI2Kwe1.description: Spend a Fear to have the @Lookup[@name] unleash a storm of lightning and thunder. Make an attack roll against 1d4+1 targets within Far range. Targets the @Lookup[@name] succeeds against take 3d12 magic damage. Then each target within Far range of the @Lookup[@name] must make an Agility Reaction Roll (20). Targets who fail take 3d8 physical damage and are pushed back to Close range. Targets who succeed must mark a Stress.

glnoG8JVxdGxNoyJ.name: Reaction Roll
glnoG8JVxdGxNoyJ.description: Then each target within Far range of the @Lookup[@name] must make an Agility Reaction Roll (20). Targets who fail take 3d8 physical damage and are pushed back to Close range. Targets who succeed must mark a Stress.

uYDndZAjve1MmeIh.name: Crushing Grasp
uYDndZAjve1MmeIh.description: When the @Lookup[@name] makes a successful standard attack, you can mark a Stress to have the @Lookup[@name] crush the target with its talons, forcing them to mark 1d4 Stress and Restraining them until they succeed on a Strength Roll (20).

OYFU3hLG9WbIEwHc.name: Grabbed
OYFU3hLG9WbIEwHc.description: You are Restrained until you succeed on a Strength Roll (20).

nrUpskylAzI4yuyF.name: Nest Warden
nrUpskylAzI4yuyF.description:
When the @Lookup[@name]'s eggs are threatened, it gains the following features:

Wrathful - Passive: The @Lookup[@name] gains a +2 bonus to its Difficulty and a bonus to damage rolls equal to the number of Stress it has marked.

Electrifying Aura - Passive: The @Lookup[@name] has resistance to magic damage. PCs who fail a roll within Very Close range must spend a Hope or mark 1d4 Stress.

QPzhKkqa0ZD50Zem.name: Wrathfull
QPzhKkqa0ZD50Zem.description: The Roc gains a +2 bonus to its Difficulty and a bonus to damage rolls equal to the number of Stress it has marked.

keCiREQB3vd49k0U.name: Base
keCiREQB3vd49k0U.description: The Roc gains a +2 bonus to its Difficulty and a bonus to damage rolls equal to the number of Stress it has marked.

BWJJE4K7vnmEYyE5.description: The Roc has resistance to magic damage. PCs who fail a roll within Very Close range must spend a Hope or mark 1d4 Stress.
