ct6djseD8SxVuYOE.name: Electrifying Aura
ct6djseD8SxVuYOE.description: The Roc has resistance to magic damage.

Ruby Dragon.name: Ruby Dragon
Ruby Dragon.description: A huge winged dragon that has visible flames beneath its glittering, gem-encrusted scales. Its body heat melts stone.
Ruby Dragon.motivesAndTactics: Crack the earth, melt, protect treasure

rS6IHk80XESxFxno.name: Relentless (3)
rS6IHk80XESxFxno.description: The Dragon can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

NlEFjJYQUwupXAdc.name: Fearsome
NlEFjJYQUwupXAdc.description: When the Dragon succeeds on an attack against a PC or a PC within Far range fails an action roll, you gain a Fear.

V1Ccn0Hi2lKYYGUt.name: Melting Breath
V1Ccn0Hi2lKYYGUt.description: Mark a Stress to have the Dragon unleash a blast of fire on all PCs in front of it within Close range. Each target must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or take 4d12+10 magic damage and mark an Armor Slot without gaining its benefits (they can still use armor to reduce the damage).

yE763wnIGXDZv0vp.name: Volcanic Fissure
yE763wnIGXDZv0vp.description: Spend a Fear to have the Dragon snap its tail against the ground, opening a lava rift that flows over the area within Close range. Each PC within that area must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who succeed immediately move out of the area. Targets who fail take 4d8+5 magic damage. Until the Dragon is defeated, a creature who enters the area takes 4d8+5 magic damage.

lrZBrdcwa2uBZFn4.name: Hot-Blooded
lrZBrdcwa2uBZFn4.description: When a creature makes a successful attack against the Dragon within Very Close range, the Dragon's blood erupts from the wound and burns the attacker, forcing them to mark an Armor Slot. If they can't mark an Armor Slot, they mark [[/r 1d4]] HP.

Rugaru.name: Rugaru
Rugaru.description: A wolf-headed humanoid cursed by the gods to prowl the swamps in search of blood.
Rugaru.motivesAndTactics: Blaspheme, go for the throat, stalk, terrorize

yrjtfPqIJlUDQstX.name: Relentless (3)
yrjtfPqIJlUDQstX.description: The @Lookup[@name] can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

Qw2l1ncgoz0uhj6g.name: Child of Night
Qw2l1ncgoz0uhj6g.description: While in moonlight, the @Lookup[@name] gains a +2 bonus to their Difficulty.

ePhg4gf1qZXgXXJ7.name: Child Of Night
ePhg4gf1qZXgXXJ7.description: While in moonlight, gain a +2 bonus to Difficulty.

NzKWVP0JBnhF6N1O.name: Bloodthirsty
NzKWVP0JBnhF6N1O.description: When a PC marks HP from the @Lookup[@name]'s standard attack, add a token to this stat block. The @Lookup[@name] gains a bonus to attack rolls equal to the number of tokens on this stat block. Clear all tokens when the @Lookup[@name] takes Severe damage.

WSR7EXOKykrozqU1.name: Bloodthirsty
WSR7EXOKykrozqU1.description: The Rugaru gains a bonus to attack rolls equal to the number of tokens on this stat block. Clear all tokens when the Rugaru takes Severe damage.

459aNwv1u6Z96MA8.name: Howl at the Moon
459aNwv1u6Z96MA8.description: Mark a Stress to force each PC within Far range to make a Presence Reaction Roll (15). Targets who fail lose a Hope. Gain a Fear for each Hope lost. If a PC has no Hope, they must mark a Stress and become Vulnerable until they roll with Hope.

xSq3CQhtc9Zd40ED.name: Frightened
xSq3CQhtc9Zd40ED.description: You are Vulnerable until you roll with Hope.

DtkRr84ignZWz1yy.name: Flesh Ripper
DtkRr84ignZWz1yy.description: Mark a Stress to make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 1d12+2 direct physical damage.

Rust Eater.name: Rust Eater
Rust Eater.description: A pony-sized cockroach coated in a corrosive chitin that turns metal into rust.
Rust Eater.motivesAndTactics: Avoid detection, eat rust, sniff out metal

gxRaxj1KC5GCLHJh.name: Stifling Pheromones
gxRaxj1KC5GCLHJh.description: A PC who makes an action roll within Very Close range of the @Lookup[@name] must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or mark a Stress.

O8sBQYNMY0ZbYwgU.name: Rust Touch
O8sBQYNMY0ZbYwgU.description: The @Lookup[@name]'s carapace is coated in a corrosive acid that pits and rusts metal. When a PC within Melee range of the Rust Easter succeeds on an attack against it with a metal weapon, reduce the weapon's damage die by one step (for example, d8 to d6 or d6 to d4). If a weapon's damage die is reduced below a d4, the weapon crumbles into rust. The @Lookup[@name] then devours the rust pile and clears a HP.

Sandwyrm.name: Sandwyrm
Sandwyrm.description: A gargantuan burrowing worm that has armor plating and gnashing jaws. This intelligent and opportunistic hunter can swim through sand as quickly as a cheetah runs on land.
Sandwyrm.motivesAndTactics: Ambush from below, eat and leave, tunnel and erupt, use both ends

LaD80Lyc7hjdTwjJ.name: Venomous Tail Stinger
LaD80Lyc7hjdTwjJ.description: Mark a Stress to attack a target within Close range. On a success, the target takes 3d10+2 physical damage and must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll or become Restrained and Vulnerable until they roll with Hope.

6b8YOplmlkPIxkkC.name: Stabbed
6b8YOplmlkPIxkkC.description: You are Restrained and Vulnerable until you roll with Hope.

3p7DukovYy3xgCHW.name: Devour
3p7DukovYy3xgCHW.description: Make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, the @Lookup[@name] Swallows the target. While Swallowed, the target is Restrained and marks a HP when the @Lookup[@name] is spotlighted. The @Lookup[@name] disgorges all Swallowed creatures when it takes Major or greater damage.

ApwIguCb3RsAdOSb.name: Swallowed
ApwIguCb3RsAdOSb.description: While Swallowed, the target is Restrained and marks a HP when the Sandwyrm is spotlighted. The Sandwyrm disgorges all Swallowed creatures when it takes Major or greater damage.

mU73FWlSsvOOlvHk.name: Hungry, Not Stupid
mU73FWlSsvOOlvHk.description: When the @Lookup[@name] marks half its HP or Swallows a creature, roll a d6. On a result of 3 or lower, the @Lookup[@name] retreats to safety.

Sawtoothed Gillbeast.name: Sawtoothed Gillbeast
Sawtoothed Gillbeast.description: A stocky fish creature that has rows of razor-sharp teeth.
Sawtoothed Gillbeast.motivesAndTactics: Clamber ashore, hit and run, peek above the waterline

yqbWInJewYL1UCg8.name: Ka-Chomp
yqbWInJewYL1UCg8.description: Mark a Stress to attack a target within Melee range. On a success, the target takes 1d12 physical damage and must mark an Armor Slot without gaining its benefit (they can still use armor to reduce the damage).

ZBpUJaH6CBqiaJUV.name: Feeding Frenzy
ZBpUJaH6CBqiaJUV.description: When a creature marks HP, you can spend a Fear to spotlight all @Lookup[@name]s within Very Close range of them. Those Gillbeasts move into Melee range of the creature and each make a standard attack against them. If any attacks succeed, combine their damage.

qufYjFc6S4uT7tkQ.name: Scaly
qufYjFc6S4uT7tkQ.description: When the Gillbeast would mark any number of HP, roll a d6. On a result of 6, you can mark a Stress instead.

Scarecrow.name: Scarecrow
Scarecrow.description: A bundle of straw bound into a humanoid shape, clothed in rags, and animated by a trapped soul.
Scarecrow.motivesAndTactics: Pull yourself together, scratch and claw

dcHBUQhvxfWNnG7p.name: Made of Straw
dcHBUQhvxfWNnG7p.description: The @Lookup[@name] has resistance to physical damage but takes double damage from fire.

nzndziuKhswzNypi.name: Made Of Straw
nzndziuKhswzNypi.description: The Scarecrow has resistance to physical damage but takes double damage from fire.

26hUFK6A4zYMUO0y.name: Terror Vision
26hUFK6A4zYMUO0y.description: Spend a Fear to have the @Lookup[@name] lock eyes with a PC within Very Close range, dealing 2d8 magic damage and making them Vulnerable until they roll with Hope.

55zNbUczLoRcpwN7.name: Terrified
55zNbUczLoRcpwN7.description: You are Vulnerable until you roll with Hope.

Severed Shadow.name: Severed Shadow
Severed Shadow.description: A two-dimensional living shadow bound to flat planes and surfaces.
Severed Shadow.motivesAndTactics: Curse the light, slip between the cracks, split and reform

sblLbyK1aQUa3p6I.name: Minion (12)
sblLbyK1aQUa3p6I.description: The Shadow is defeated when it takes any damage. For every 12 damage a PC deals to the Shadow, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range that the attack would succeed against.

hI0tXM7hL3Tf3oLs.name: Shadow Grapple
hI0tXM7hL3Tf3oLs.description: Mark a Stress to make an attack against a target within Close range. On a success, the target becomes Vulnerable and must mark a Stress when they take an action until the Shadow is defeated.

F2npLpE2LeXlbcna.name: Shadow Grappled
F2npLpE2LeXlbcna.description: You are Vulnerable and must mark a Stress when you take an action until the Shadow is defeated.

FWGH5sUYmjPAyESD.name: Group Attack
FWGH5sUYmjPAyESD.description: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all @Lookup[@name]s within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 10 magic damage each. Combine this damage.

Shapeshifting Fiend.name: Shapeshifting Fiend
Shapeshifting Fiend.description: An evil entity who impersonates a trusted figure.

pnMA6UWprfKjTu5m.name: Fiendish Nature
pnMA6UWprfKjTu5m.description: The Fiend has resistance to magic damage and can't be fooled by magic illusions.

sPtaHnm0uxvSDpgi.name: Fiendish Nature
sPtaHnm0uxvSDpgi.description: The Fiend has resistance to magic damage and can't be fooled by magic illusions.

VrUFHMjVrWUc2JHd.name: Impersonate
VrUFHMjVrWUc2JHd.description: Spend a Fear to have the Fiend magically transform into a humanoid they have previously interacted with. A PC who targets the Fiend while they're in the form of a person the PC cares for must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or the attack fails and the PC must mark a Stress.

rHcoEUjYExrZuhhR.name: Impersonating
rHcoEUjYExrZuhhR.description: The Fiend has magically transformed into a humanoid they have previously interacted with. A PC who targets the Fiend while they're in the form of a person the PC cares for must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or the attack fails and the PC must mark a Stress.

MIvcup4AWUoqBMKq.name: Turn Invisible
MIvcup4AWUoqBMKq.description: Mark a Stress to make the Fiend Hidden until they make an action roll or take damage.

Sny2sOnoxiehgEeI.name: Invisible
Sny2sOnoxiehgEeI.description: The Fiend is Hidden until they make an action roll or take damage.

DH3qyIQPoi3soxdU.name: Backhanded Guidance
DH3qyIQPoi3soxdU.description: When a PC makes an action roll while the Fiend is in the scene, you can mark a Stress to add 1d6 to the result of their Fear Die.

KejigtjcSGCBpGh3.name: Exposed! (Phase Change)
KejigtjcSGCBpGh3.description: When the Fiend is defeated or the PCs discover its true identity, replace the Fiend with @Lookup[@name] Revealed and immediately spotlight them.

Shapeshifting Fiend Revealed.name: Shapeshifting Fiend Revealed
Shapeshifting Fiend Revealed.description: A towering humanoid who has an insectile head and multiple sets of glowing red eyes.
Shapeshifting Fiend Revealed.motivesAndTactics: Claim souls, confuse and misdirect, escape to the Circles Below, teleport

EK5pZuDxvOPjmRpF.name: Relentless (3)
EK5pZuDxvOPjmRpF.description: The Fiend can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

9JFN23WxLTzAJlTO.description: The Fiend has resistance to magic damage and can't be fooled by magic illusions.

When the Fiend is targeted by an attack, they gain a bonus to their Difficulty equal to the countdown die's current value. The countdown ticks down when a PC fails an attack against the Fiend. When it triggers, the duplicates vanish.

jI2kPd7ivBDRArp7.description: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all @Lookup[@name]s within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 1 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

Viscera Sucker.name: Viscera Sucker
Viscera Sucker.description: A vampiric demon whose upper body detaches at sundown to fly through nearby villages in search of victims. It has a winged upper body with hanging entrails.
Viscera Sucker.motivesAndTactics: Clamp onto prey, suck blood, tear in half

RxBlE5YjrtWE5Bzo.name: Join or Die
RxBlE5YjrtWE5Bzo.description: The @Lookup[@name] dies if it hasn't reconnected its upper and lower halves by dawn.

JvUiFinQ8enXA8Pu.name: Entangling Entrails
JvUiFinQ8enXA8Pu.description: Spend a Fear to have the @Lookup[@name] latch onto a target within Very Close range, Restraining them until they escape with a successful Strength Roll (16).

NUGvJQQ3xFB3xBPl.name: Entangling Entrails
NUGvJQQ3xFB3xBPl.description: You are Restrained them until you escape with a successful Strength Roll (16).

KllqAajty0xJ3wGK.name: Lifesuck
KllqAajty0xJ3wGK.description: Mark a Stress to have the @Lookup[@name] drink blood from a Restrained target within Melee range. The target marks a HP, and the @Lookup[@name] clears a HP.

Water Mother.name: Water Mother
Water Mother.description: A colossal fur-covered snake that hunts in large bodies of water.
Water Mother.motivesAndTactics: Constrict the world, control the battlefield, draw enemies into the water

5cxpr0Fie0sBbZWL.name: Segmented
5cxpr0Fie0sBbZWL.description: The @Lookup[@name]'s body is divided into three segments: Head, Center, and Tail. The @Lookup[@name] always moves from the Head first, pulling the Center and then Tail behind it. A creature can target the @Lookup[@name] with an attack as long as at least one of her segments is within range, but the @Lookup[@name] can make a standard attack only against a target within range of her Head. If an attack deals damage to the @Lookup[@name] and her Head is within range, the attack deals an extra 1d10 damage.

3R0HRksFmQaKyLk4.name: Eat the World
3R0HRksFmQaKyLk4.description: Spend a Fear to have the @Lookup[@name] inhale sharply. Each PC within Close range of her Head must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll or mark a Stress and be pulled within Melee range of the Head. The @Lookup[@name] then makes a standard attack against all targets within Melee range of her Head.

2jD66IGYZIZF385K.name: Constrict
2jD66IGYZIZF385K.description: Mark a Stress to make an attack against all targets within Melee range of the Center segment. Targets the attack succeeds against take 4d8+8 physical damage and are temporarily Restrained. At the beginning of each GM turn, you can mark a Stress to force all targets Restrained by the @Lookup[@name] to mark a HP.

ETaF5f5bWNjbNXy1.name: Constrict Damage
ETaF5f5bWNjbNXy1.description: At the beginning of each GM turn, you can mark a Stress to force all targets Restrained by the @Lookup[@name] to mark a HP.

zL85SlJ9d11PI9mu.name: Venom Surge
zL85SlJ9d11PI9mu.description: When the @Lookup[@name] makes a successful standard attack, you can spend a Fear to make the target Vulnerable until the end of the scene.

5cXRi8ot13KpuWda.name: New Effect
5cXRi8ot13KpuWda.description: You are Vulnerable until the end of the scene.

Waxwork Creation.name: Waxwork Creation
Waxwork Creation.description: A ten-foot-tall, semisolid (and semisentient) candle wax construct.
Waxwork Creation.motivesAndTactics: Lumber menacingly, moan with the pain of unlife, smother

S9vdn0BC45USdjoY.name: Relentless (2)
S9vdn0BC45USdjoY.description: The Creation can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

cJWcBnIIzvlJJXXR.name: No Vital Organs
cJWcBnIIzvlJJXXR.description: The Creation doesn't take extra damage from attacks that critically succeed against it.

UvSOP0XRfwNbb3AJ.name: Wax Ball
UvSOP0XRfwNbb3AJ.description: Mark a Stress to have the Creation throw a ball of wax at a target within Far range. Make an attack against the target. On a success, the target takes 1d12+2 physical damage and becomes Restrained until they succeed on a Strength Roll (15).

BmYvqcNDl5s9IwWG.name: Waxed
BmYvqcNDl5s9IwWG.description: You are Restrained until you succeed on a Strength Roll (15).

gHOZZ13hhgkfoZxT.name: Splutch!
gHOZZ13hhgkfoZxT.description: When a PC within Melee range of the Creation makes a weapon attack against it, roll a d6. On a 5 or higher, the attacker's weapon gets stuck in the Creation and can be removed only with a successful Strength Roll (15).

r4mjPUNduekltP80.name: My Weapon!
r4mjPUNduekltP80.description: Your weapon is stuck in the Creation and can be removed only with a successful Strength Roll (15).

SHRHEhHe806ArGEl.name: Smothering Grapple
SHRHEhHe806ArGEl.description: When the Creation makes a successful standard attack against a target within Melee range, you can spend a Fear to Trap the target inside the Creation's wax body. While Trapped, the target is Restrained and must mark a Stress and move with the Creation each time it's spotlighted. A Trapped creature is freed when the Creation takes Major or greater damage.

40SCDzsRQFQEwcss.name: Trapped
40SCDzsRQFQEwcss.description: While Trapped, the target is Restrained and must mark a Stress and move with the Creation each time it's spotlighted. A Trapped creature is freed when the Creation takes Major or greater damage.

Whisper Wraith.name: Whisper Wraith
Whisper Wraith.description: The echoes of broken promises and dreams unfulfilled, manifesting as a floating, translucent shroud of tattered black velvet in a vaguely humanoid shape.
Whisper Wraith.motivesAndTactics: Bind limbs, drop from a great height, lift off the ground, swirl through the air, wrap around heads

3YzhBn75pkj2eaEq.name: Greater Specter
3YzhBn75pkj2eaEq.description: The Wraith has resistance to physical damage and can move through solid objects.

8I6KGjMsDNry8yYe.name: Greater Specter
8I6KGjMsDNry8yYe.description: The Wraith has resistance to physical damage and can move through solid objects.

KUEN8QB4OPx654Uv.name: Spooky
KUEN8QB4OPx654Uv.description: When the Wraith makes a successful attack, all PCs within Close range must mark a Stress, and you gain a Fear.

xv9RMHx3YZpoLg28.name: Nightmare Shroud
xv9RMHx3YZpoLg28.description: Spend a Fear to have the Wraith wrap itself around a PC within Melee range, Shrouding the target until they succeed on a Strength Roll to dislodge the Wraith or the Wraith takes Major or greater damage. While Shrouded, the target has disadvantage on attack rolls and marks a Stress when they roll with Fear. Additionally, damage that would be dealt to the Wraith is split evenly between the Wraith and the Shrouded target.

jrt0gGd5D46DU6sE.name: Shrouded
jrt0gGd5D46DU6sE.description:
You are Shrouded until you succeed on a Strength Roll to dislodge the Wraith or the Wraith takes Major or greater damage.

While Shrouded, you have disadvantage on attack rolls and mark a Stress when you roll with Fear. Additionally, damage that would be dealt to the Wraith is split evenly between the Wraith and you.

Will-o'-the-wisps.name: Will-o'-the-wisps
Will-o'-the-wisps.motivesAndTactics: Dazzle and distract, disorient, lead astray

A6LQpawx7obs9Xok.name: Horde (1d4-1)
A6LQpawx7obs9Xok.description: When the @Lookup[@name] have marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals 1d4-1 magic damage instead.

lKtZDU4j2FDWtF38.name: Kaleidoscopic
lKtZDU4j2FDWtF38.description: The @Lookup[@name] pulse and dance in hypnotic, color-changing patterns that entrance any creature who looks upon them. All targets within Very Close range of the @Lookup[@name] are Vulnerable.

fPWnXgxGnlfZXyto.name: Fascinating
fPWnXgxGnlfZXyto.description: Spend a Fear to have the @Lookup[@name] trace looping light trails through the air, leaving afterimages that beg to be deciphered. Each PC within Far range must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll (13) or mark a Stress and move up to Close range toward the @Lookup[@name].

Wyrmfiend.name: Wyrmfiend
Wyrmfiend.description: A reptilian biped created by mysterious and ancient dragon magic. Wyrmfiends exist more as extensions of their draconic master's will than as individual beings.
Wyrmfiend.motivesAndTactics: Hold the line, sacrifice, serve, swarm

JWxL57vzZ3m1ZTol.name: Minion (13)
JWxL57vzZ3m1ZTol.description: The @Lookup[@name] is defeated when it takes any damage. For every 13 damage a PC deals to the @Lookup[@name], the PC defeats an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

6pSw0TNcqS5hRJz3.name: Venomous Bite
6pSw0TNcqS5hRJz3.description: Spend a Fear to make an attack against a PC within Melee range. On a success, deal 4d4+4 physical damage and Poison the target until they succeed on a Strength Roll (20). While Poisoned, the target must roll a d6 before they make an action roll. On a result of 4 or lower, the target must mark a Stress.

EcfoVtIMihFMRo0a.name: Poisoned
EcfoVtIMihFMRo0a.description:
You are Poisoned until you succeed on a Strength Roll (20).

While Poisoned, you must roll a d6 before you make an action roll. On a result of 4 or lower, you must mark a Stress.

8sEbqLIwwCPYj6Oo.name: Group Attack
8sEbqLIwwCPYj6Oo.description: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all @Lookup[@name]s within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 11 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

Wyrmlings.name: Wyrmlings
Wyrmlings.description: A clutch of newly hatched dragons. As newborns, they're furious, hungry, and stupid.

MBr2VXrxSLztwRp1.name: Horde (2d6+5)
MBr2VXrxSLztwRp1.description: When the @Lookup[@name] have marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals 2d6+5 physical damage instead.

0V472TOtSicWIeo5.name: Ravenous
0V472TOtSicWIeo5.description: Once per GM turn when a PC marks a HP from an attack made by the @Lookup[@name], you can spend a Fear to spotlight the @Lookup[@name] again.

4YHJFU5RYQJqHK7a.name: Overwhelm
4YHJFU5RYQJqHK7a.description: When the @Lookup[@name] take Minor damage from an attack within Melee range, you can mark a Stress to make a standard attack with advantage against the attacker.

Wyvern.name: Wyvern
Wyvern.description: A two-legged dragon that flies from its mountaintop aerie to devour livestock.
Wyvern.motivesAndTactics: Cast a long shadow, snatch and grab, wheel through the air

6FmuJDEwZ1Yq6Krt.name: Double Strike
6FmuJDEwZ1Yq6Krt.description: Mark a Stress to have the @Lookup[@name] make two standard attacks. If both attacks succeed against the same target, combine the damage.

3yZ5cnA8C3zknz1A.name: Terrifying Shriek
3yZ5cnA8C3zknz1A.description: Spend a Fear to have the @Lookup[@name] let out a spine-chilling screech. All PCs within Far range are Terrified until they succeed on a Presence Roll (18) to clear the condition or the @Lookup[@name] is defeated. While Terrified, a PC doesn't gain a Hope when they roll with Hope.

PpDXBf2b5FirQfjI.name: Terrified
PpDXBf2b5FirQfjI.description: You are Terrified until you succeed on a Presence Roll (18) to clear the condition or the Wyvern is defeated. While Terrified, you do not gain a Hope when you roll with Hope.

ERw6SnOIhJA2wWdH.name: Clutch
ERw6SnOIhJA2wWdH.description: When the @Lookup[@name] makes a successful attack against a PC, you can spend a Fear to have the @Lookup[@name] Restrain the target in its claws until the PC succeeds on a Strength Roll (18) or the @Lookup[@name] takes Major or greater damage. While Restrained in this way, the PC has disadvantage on attack rolls.

IRN9xFgqn91fgjag.name: Clutched
IRN9xFgqn91fgjag.description:
You are Restrained in the Wyvern's claws until you succeed on a Strength Roll (18) or the Wyvern takes Major or greater damage.

While Restrained in this way, you have disadvantage on attack rolls.

Xero The Castle Killer.name: Xero The Castle Killer
Xero The Castle Killer.motivesAndTactics: Leave a wake of destruction, level buildings, stomp through settlements

7gkyVbn0Nr4skpXL.name: Relentless (X)
7gkyVbn0Nr4skpXL.description: Xero can be spotlighted up to X times per GM turn, where X is the number of PCs in the scene. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

N9r9oP22shMRiFkZ.name: Collateral Damage
N9r9oP22shMRiFkZ.description: Xero's movement can't be hindered, impeded, or affected by anything other than natural terrain. All destructible terrain or obstacles in Xero's path are destroyed when Xero moves through them.

fIwOU4wmQqE7ftDy.name: Gigaton Stomp
fIwOU4wmQqE7ftDy.description: Spend a Fear to have Xero bring its foot down hard, creating a localized earthquake. Each PC within Melee range takes 4d12 physical damage and is Restrained until they wriggle out with a successful Finesse Roll. Each creature beyond Melee range but within Close range must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or be knocked back to Far range. If a target is knocked back, they must either mark an Armor Slot or take 4d12 physical damage as they land.

pgQdboWE1V81exza.name: Stomped
pgQdboWE1V81exza.description: You are Restrained until you wriggle out with a successful Finesse Roll

csNQFwxN8PQH14lT.name: Power Slide
csNQFwxN8PQH14lT.description: Mark a Stress to move up to Close range. Each PC Xero moves through must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll or choose to either mark 2 Armor Slots or take Severe damage.

ZfCW3kRWg5bXFDes.name: Radioactive Breath
ZfCW3kRWg5bXFDes.description: Spend a Fear to have Xero charge up a nuclear beam. Place a token on this stat block. The next time Xero is spotlighted, you can spend this token and unleash a beam to Very Far range. The beam has a width of Close range. Each PC in this area must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 4d12+12 direct magic damage. Targets who succeed take half damage. Xero can't use this feature again until it takes Severe damage.

ExvMjIBxdm4FY7LJ.name: Charge
ExvMjIBxdm4FY7LJ.description: Spend a Fear to have Xero charge up a nuclear beam. Place a token on this stat block.

fi9EpIvWbWdOy0Cx.name: Regeneration
fi9EpIvWbWdOy0Cx.description: Up to three times per scene, spend any number of Fear to clear an equal number of HP.

Young Fire Dragon.name: Young Fire Dragon
Young Fire Dragon.description: A crimson dragon with four powerful limbs and smoldering wings.
Young Fire Dragon.motivesAndTactics: Burn, defend lair, erupt, fly, shred, take

CCjwbRFO8lPwUz56.name: Relentless (3)
CCjwbRFO8lPwUz56.description: The Dragon can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

AyOAvxE5ruRgzuTn.name: Intimidating
AyOAvxE5ruRgzuTn.description: When you spend a Fear to spotlight the Dragon, all PCs within Close range must mark a Stress or lose a Hope.

XkdQ0bpcZvVAobY7.name: Flame Breath
XkdQ0bpcZvVAobY7.description: Spend a Fear to have the Dragon unleash a blast of flame against all targets in front of it within Close range. Each target must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 4d8+3 magic damage. Targets who succeed must mark a Stress or take half damage. A target who marks HP from this attack also becomes Vulnerable until they clear a HP.

AETDJMLedUcefdNe.name: Eruption
AETDJMLedUcefdNe.description: Spend a Fear to have the Dragon crack the earth open with its tail, unleashing an explosion of lava. Choose a point within Far range. Each PC on the line between the Dragon and the chosen point must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or get burned, becoming Vulnerable until their next rest. You gain a Fear for each PC who fails.

9mHaYwq5ZmXqnA1Z.name: Blazing Scales
9mHaYwq5ZmXqnA1Z.description: When a creature within Very Close range attacks the Dragon, the attacker must mark a Stress.

0NBluEfJGwQWmYTo.name: Slash and Burn
0NBluEfJGwQWmYTo.description: When the Dragon makes a successful standard attack, you gain a Fear and can mark a Stress to have the attack deal an extra 10 magic damage.

Yufo.name: Yufo
Yufo.description: A large, interdimensional jellyfishlike creature that floats in and out of the timestream.
Yufo.motivesAndTactics: Exchange information about possible timelines, feed on heightened emotions, watch from the shadows

YBQ9BpaOeef4iBms.name: Telepathic
YBQ9BpaOeef4iBms.description: The @Lookup[@name] can mentally communicate with creatures within Very Far range.

q10WSdhUvw2GY2cy.name: Psychic Strongbox
q10WSdhUvw2GY2cy.description: The @Lookup[@name] is immune to abilities and features that would affect or alter its thoughts or emotions.

9nSzgCYB4d3gbvIj.name: Glitch Wave
9nSzgCYB4d3gbvIj.description: Spend a Fear and choose up to three targets within Close range. Each target must succeed on a Instinct Reaction Roll or become desynced from reality and have disadvantage on Instinct Rolls until they use a downtime move to ground their psyches in the now.

i3PqojBeBweHCumM.name: Desynced
i3PqojBeBweHCumM.description: You have disadvantage on Instinct Rolls until you use a downtime move to ground your psyches in the now.

k4M4bnm9yPPLqOfn.name: Temporal Corrosion
k4M4bnm9yPPLqOfn.description: When the @Lookup[@name] succeeds on a standard attack, you can mark a Stress to have the @Lookup[@name] excrete an entropic acid through its skin, giving the target a -2 penalty to their damage thresholds until they use a downtime move to repair their armor.

TlHq918re4n0awjW.name: New Effect
TlHq918re4n0awjW.description: You have a -2 penalty to your damage thresholds until you use a downtime move to repair your armor.
